items.title: "How Do You Not Lose Friends?": Synthesizing a Design Space of Social Controls for Securing Shared Digital Resources Via Participatory Design Jams.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文通过参与式设计工作坊（Participatory Design Jams）的方法，探讨了在共享数字资源（如家庭共享账户、工作组文档等）场景中，用户如何通过社会控制机制（social controls）来平衡安全性与人际关系的维护。研究背景指出，现有的安全机制（如强密码、多因素认证）虽然能提升安全性，但往往忽视了用户之间的社会关系，可能导致用户为了不破坏关系而采取不安全的行为。核心问题是：如何设计用户可接受的社会控制措施，使其既能保护共享资源，又能维护用户之间的信任与友谊？研究采用了协同设计的方法，邀请了多组参与者（如家庭成员、室友、同事等）共同参与设计工作坊，通过角色扮演、场景构思等方式，生成了一系列社会控制策略。主要贡献包括：（1）提炼出一个社会控制设计空间，包含“透明度”、“可协商性”、“归因”等维度；（2）提出了多种具体的社会控制机制，如“共享密码更改通知”、“资源使用日志”、“可定制的访问权限”等；（3）通过参与者反馈评估了这些机制的可行性与用户接受度。研究发现，用户更倾向于具有可逆性和透明度的控制措施，而过于严格的监控可能损害关系。该研究适合HCI、安全设计及社交计算领域的研究者阅读，为设计兼顾安全与人际关系的共享资源保护方案提供了理论指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了安全机制设计中常被忽视的社会维度，为家庭、团队等共享场景下的安全方案提供了以人为本的设计框架，能帮助安全工程师避免因过度强化技术控制而破坏用户关系。

items.title: Web Cache Deception Escalates!

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文题为《Web Cache Deception Escalates!》，旨在系统性地扩展和深化对Web缓存欺骗（Web Cache Deception）攻击的理解。Web缓存欺骗是一种利用Web服务器与缓存服务器之间行为差异的攻击技术，攻击者通过构造巧妙的HTTP请求，诱使缓存服务器将包含敏感信息（如会话令牌、个人数据）的响应缓存下来，进而使其他用户（包括攻击者）能够从缓存中获取这些信息。传统的研究主要关注简单缓存配置下的攻击场景，而本文作者团队通过大规模实证分析，揭示了在现代Web基础设施（如CDN、反向代理、负载均衡器）以及复杂应用逻辑下，该攻击存在多种升级变种。具体而言，论文提出了三种新的攻击类别：基于路径混淆的升级、基于内容类型操纵的方法以及利用缓存键（Cache Key）设计缺陷的技术。作者通过自动化扫描工具对Alexa Top 10K网站进行评估，发现大量网站仍然存在被利用的风险，且现有防护措施（如设置正确的缓存头、使用Vary头部）在新型攻击面前效果有限。此外，论文还分析了不同CDN提供商（如Cloudflare、Akamai、Fastly）的行为差异，指出攻击者可能利用提供商之间的协作漏洞。实验证明，攻击成功率可达较高比例，且影响范围从早期的静态资源扩展到动态API端点。该工作为防御者提供了更全面的威胁模型，并为设计更鲁棒的缓存策略提供了指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Web缓存欺骗是当前Web安全中常被低估的威胁，本文揭示的升级攻击面可能在真实环境中导致大规模数据泄露，值得CDN运营商和网站管理员重新评估缓存策略。

items.title: DeepPhish: Understanding User Trust Towards Artificially Generated Profiles in Online Social Networks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了在线社交网络中用户对AI生成的个人资料（即深度伪造资料）的信任程度。研究通过设计实验，让参与者评估真实与AI生成的个人资料的可信度，发现用户难以区分真实与伪造资料，且对伪造资料的信任度较高。论文提出了一个名为DeepPhish的框架，用于生成高度逼真的伪造社交资料，并分析了用户信任的影响因素。实验结果表明，用户对个人资料的信任主要基于资料中的视觉元素（如头像）和文本信息（如个人简介），而AI生成的资料在这些方面已经达到与真实资料难以区分的水平。研究还发现，用户的信任决策受到其社交媒体使用经验的影响，但总体趋势是容易被伪造资料欺骗。这项工作揭示了社交工程攻击的新趋势，即利用AI生成虚假个人资料进行钓鱼攻击，并强调了提高用户警觉性和开发检测工具的必要性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了AI生成虚假社交资料对用户信任的威胁，为防御社交工程攻击提供了重要参考。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了AI生成虚假社交资料对用户信任的威胁，为防御社交工程攻击提供了重要参考。

items.title: Empirical Understanding of Deletion Privacy: Experiences, Expectations, and Measures.
items.summary: Social platforms are heavily used by individuals to share their thoughts and personal information. However, due to regret over time about posting inappropriate social content, embarrassment, or even life or relationship changes, some past posts might also pose serious privacy concerns for them. To cope with these privacy concerns, social platforms offer deletion mechanisms that allow users to remove their contents. Quite naturally, these deletion mechanisms are really useful for removing past posts as and when needed. However, these same mechanisms also leave the users potentially vulnerable to attacks by adversaries who specifically seek the users' damaging content and exploit the act of deletion as a strong signal for identifying such content. Unfortunately, today user experiences and contextual expectations regarding such attacks on deletion privacy and deletion privacy in general are not well understood. To that end, in this paper, we conduct a user survey-based exploration involving 191 participants to unpack their prior deletion experiences, their expectations of deletion privacy, and how effective they find the current deletion mechanisms. We find that more than 80% of the users have deleted at least a social media post, and users self-reported that, on average, around 35% of their deletions happened after a week of posting. While the participants identified the irrelevancy (due to time passing) as the main reason for content removal, most of them believed that deletions indicate that the deleted content includes some damaging information to the owner. Importantly, the participants are significantly more concerned about their deletions being noticed by large-scale data collectors (e.g., the government) than individuals from their social circle. Finally, the participants felt that popular deletion mechanisms are not very effective in protecting the privacy of those deletions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文通过用户调查（191名参与者）深入研究了社交平台上的删除隐私问题。研究背景是用户因后悔、尴尬或生活变化而删除过去发布的帖子，但这一行为可能被对手利用，将删除作为识别敏感内容的强信号。当前对用户删除隐私的经历、期望以及现有删除机制有效性的理解不足。作者设计并实施了一项在线调查，主要发现包括：超过80%的用户曾删除至少一条社交媒体帖子；用户自我报告平均约35%的删除行为发生在发布一周后；用户认为内容过时是删除的主要原因，但多数参与者相信删除行为暗示被删除内容包含对所有者有损害的信息；参与者更担心大规模数据收集者（如政府）注意到其删除行为，而非社交圈内的个人；最后，参与者普遍认为流行的删除机制在保护删除隐私方面效果不佳。该研究揭示了删除隐私面临的双重挑战：用户需要删除功能来管理隐私，但该功能也可能成为攻击者的信号。论文贡献在于首次系统性地从用户角度理解删除隐私，为设计更隐私友好的删除机制提供了实证依据。适合隐私研究人员、社交平台设计者和安全策略制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了社交平台删除功能可能被攻击者用于定位用户敏感内容，而用户对此隐私风险认知不足且现有机制保护不力，对SOC分析用户行为、设计隐私防护策略具有重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响社交平台隐私设计，可迁移至任何具有删除功能的在线服务（如论坛、云存储）的隐私风险评估。

items.title: Your Microphone Array Retains Your Identity: A Robust Voice Liveness Detection System for Smart Speakers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对智能音箱面临的语音重放攻击（即攻击者播放预录的合法用户语音来欺骗音箱）提出了一种鲁棒的语音活性检测（Voice Liveness Detection, VLD）系统。现有VLD方法通常依赖单个麦克风提取声学特征（如频谱、倒谱），但容易被高质量重放攻击绕过。作者创新性地利用智能音箱通常配备的麦克风阵列（多个麦克风）来提取空间声学特征：不同用户声音到达各麦克风的时间差（TDOA）和相位差构成独特的“声纹指纹”，而重放语音由于经过扬声器再传播，其空间特征与真实人声存在差异。系统设计包括：1）利用麦克风阵列采集多通道音频；2）提取基于到达时间差和相位差的特征向量；3）训练轻量级二分类器（如SVM或小神经网络）区分真实语音与重放语音。在包含多种环境、说话人、攻击设备的实际场景下进行实验，数据集涵盖不同距离、角度和重放设备（手机、笔记本电脑等）。结果表明，该系统的检测准确率超过98%，对高质量重放攻击的鲁棒性显著优于传统单麦克风方法，且计算开销低，适合部署在资源受限的智能音箱上。主要贡献包括：首次将麦克风阵列空间特征用于智能音箱VLD；提出了鲁棒的特征提取与分类框架；在真实环境中验证了有效性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能音箱广泛部署，语音重放攻击威胁用户隐私与财产安全。本文利用现有硬件（麦克风阵列）即可实现高精度活体检测，为设备厂商提供了低成本、易集成的防御方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于所有配备麦克风阵列的智能音箱、智能家居中枢等设备，提升对重放攻击的检测能力。
detection_signals_zh: 麦克风阵列各通道间的到达时间差（TDOA）异常
空间特征偏离真实人声分布
defense_advice_zh: 在智能音箱固件或驱动层集成该系统
定期更新分类模型以对抗新型攻击
结合声纹识别与活性检测构建多层防御

items.why_it_matters: 智能音箱广泛部署，语音重放攻击威胁用户隐私与财产安全。本文利用现有硬件（麦克风阵列）即可实现高精度活体检测，为设备厂商提供了低成本、易集成的防御方案。

items.title: REPLICAWATCHER: Training-less Anomaly Detection in Containerized Microservices.
items.summary: Despite its detection capabilities against previously unseen threats, anomaly detection suffers from critical limitations, which often prevent its deployment in real-world settings.In fact, anomaly-based intrusion detection systems rely on comprehensive pre-established baselines for effectively identifying suspicious activities.Unfortunately, prior research showed that these baselines age and gradually lose their effectiveness over time, especially in dynamic deployments such as microservices-based environments, where the concept of "normality" is frequently redefined due to shifting operational conditions.This scenario reinforces the need for periodic retraining to uphold optimal performance -a process that proves challenging, particularly in the context of security applications.We propose a novel, training-less approach to monitoring microservices-based environments.Our system, REPLI-CAWATCHER, observes the behavior of identical container instances (i.e., replicas) and detects anomalies without requiring prior training.Our key insight is that replicas, adopted for fault tolerance or scalability reasons, execute analogous tasks and exhibit similar behavioral patterns, which allow anomalous containers to stand out as a notable deviation from their corresponding replicas, thereby serving as a crucial indicator of security threats.The results of our experimental evaluation show that our approach is resilient against normality shifts and maintains its effectiveness without the necessity for retraining.Besides, despite not relying on a training phase, REPLICAWATCHER performs comparably to state-of-the-art, training-based solutions, achieving an average precision of 91.08% and recall of 98.35%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需训练即可检测容器化微服务环境中异常行为的新方法 REPLICAWATCHER。传统的基于异常的入侵检测系统需要建立全面的行为基线，但在微服务等动态环境中，“正常”概念频繁变化，导致基线老化并逐渐失效，需要定期重新训练，这在安全应用场景中颇具挑战。REPLICAWATCHER 的核心洞察是：微服务中为容错或可扩展性而部署的副本（replicas）会执行类似任务并呈现相似行为模式。通过实时观察同一服务的多个容器实例的行为，任何偏离其对应副本的显著差异都可作为安全威胁的重要指标。该方法完全无需训练阶段，避免了基线更新和模型老化问题。实验评估表明，REPLICAWATCHER 对正常行为偏移具有鲁棒性，无需重新训练即可保持有效性。与最先进的基于训练的方法相比，其性能相当，平均精确率达 91.08%，召回率达 98.35%。该研究适用于安全运维工程师、微服务架构师及威胁检测研究人员，尤其适合动态变化环境下的异常检测场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出一种无监督、无训练的实时异常检测方案，直接解决微服务环境中基线老化难题，避免频繁重训练开销，对提升动态基础设施的安全性具有实际意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响容器化微服务环境下的入侵检测和运行时安全监控，可迁移至云原生应用、无服务器计算等动态系统。
detection_signals_zh: 同一服务多个副本间行为模式的显著偏差
某个容器实例的指标（如系统调用、资源使用）与同组副本均值差异超过阈值
defense_advice_zh: 在微服务集群中部署副本行为监控系统，实时对比同一服务不同副本的关键指标
将副本偏差作为安全告警的补充特征，结合其他检测手段降低误报

items.why_it_matters: 提出一种无监督、无训练的实时异常检测方案，直接解决微服务环境中基线老化难题，避免频繁重训练开销，对提升动态基础设施的安全性具有实际意义。

items.title: Phoenix: Surviving Unpatched Vulnerabilities via Accurate and Efficient Filtering of Syscall Sequences.
items.summary: Known, but unpatched vulnerabilities represent one of the most concerning threats for businesses today.The average time-to-patch of zero-day vulnerabilities remains around 100 days in recent years.The lack of means to mitigate an unpatched vulnerability may force businesses to temporarily shut down their services, which can lead to significant financial loss.Existing solutions for filtering system calls unused by a container can effectively reduce the general attack surface, but cannot prevent a specific vulnerability that shares the same system calls with the container.On the other hand, existing provenance analysis solutions can help identify a sequence of system calls behind the vulnerability, although they do not provide a direct solution for filtering such a sequence.To bridge such a research gap, we propose Phoenix, a solution for preventing exploits of unpatched vulnerabilities by accurately and efficiently filtering sequences of system calls identified through provenance analysis.To achieve this, Phoenix cleverly combines the efficiency of Seccomp filters with the accuracy of Ptrace-based deep argument inspection, and it provides the novel capability of filtering system call sequences through a dynamic Seccomp design.Our implementation and experiments show that Phoenix can effectively mitigate real-world vulnerabilities which evade existing solutions, while introducing negligible delay (less than 4%) and less overhead (e.g., 98% less CPU consumption than existing solution).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文针对已知但未打补丁的漏洞（unpatched vulnerabilities）给企业带来的严重威胁，提出了一套名为Phoenix的解决方案。当前零日漏洞的平均修复时间（time-to-patch）仍高达约100天，缺乏缓解手段的企业可能被迫临时关闭服务，造成重大经济损失。现有方法如通过seccomp过滤容器未使用的系统调用，虽能减少攻击面，但无法防御与容器正常行为共享相同系统调用的特定漏洞；另一方面，溯源分析（provenance analysis）虽能识别漏洞背后的系统调用序列，但未提供直接过滤该序列的方法。Phoenix填补了这一空白：它通过精确且高效地过滤经溯源分析识别的系统调用序列，来阻止对未打补丁漏洞的利用。其核心创新在于巧妙结合了seccomp过滤器的高效性与基于ptrace的深度参数检查的准确性，并通过一种动态seccomp设计实现了过滤系统调用序列的新能力。实验表明，Phoenix能有效缓解逃避现有解决方案的真实世界漏洞，同时引入可忽略的延迟（低于4%）和更低的开销（例如CPU消耗比现有方案减少98%）。该研究适合安全运营团队、系统管理员及漏洞研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 企业普遍面临漏洞修复窗口期长的问题，Phoenix提供了一种无需等待补丁即可阻断漏洞利用的实用方法，显著降低被攻击风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于容器化环境或任何需要细粒度系统调用过滤的场景，尤其对关键业务服务中断容忍度低的企业具有直接价值。

items.why_it_matters: 企业普遍面临漏洞修复窗口期长的问题，Phoenix提供了一种无需等待补丁即可阻断漏洞利用的实用方法，显著降低被攻击风险。

items.title: Acoustic Keystroke Leakage on Smart Televisions.
items.summary: Smart Televisions (TVs) are internet-connected TVs that support video streaming applications and web browsers.Users enter information into Smart TVs through on-screen virtual keyboards.These keyboards require users to navigate between keys with directional commands from a remote controller.Given the extensive functionality of Smart TVs, users type sensitive information (e.g., passwords) into these devices, making keystroke privacy necessary.This work develops and demonstrates a new side-channel attack that exposes keystrokes from the audio of two popular Smart TVs: Apple and Samsung.This side-channel attack exploits how Smart TVs make different sounds when selecting a key, moving the cursor, and deleting a character.These properties allow an attacker to extract the number of cursor movements between selections from the TV's audio.Our attack uses this extracted information to identify the likeliest typed strings.Against realistic users, the attack finds up to 33.33% of credit card details and 60.19% of common passwords within 100 guesses.This vulnerability has been acknowledged by Samsung and highlights how Smart TVs must better protect sensitive data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 智能电视作为互联网连接的电视设备，广泛支持视频流媒体应用和网页浏览。用户通过屏幕上的虚拟键盘进行信息输入，例如密码、信用卡号等敏感数据。这类键盘依赖遥控器的方向键选择字符，而不同操作（如按键选择、光标移动、删除字符）会产生不同的声音。本文针对苹果和三星两款主流智能电视，开发并展示了一种新型声学侧信道攻击方法，能够从电视发出的音频中提取用户的键盘输入。该方法利用不同操作的声音差异，推断出每次选择之间的光标移动次数，从而限制可能的输入序列。攻击者通过远程或本地录音获取电视音频，无需物理接触设备。实验表明，在合理猜测次数（100次）内，该攻击能成功恢复最多33.33%的信用卡信息（如卡号）和60.19%的常见密码。该漏洞已被三星官方确认，凸显了智能电视在保护敏感数据方面的不足。研究贡献包括：(1) 首次系统性地研究智能电视声学键盘泄漏问题；(2) 提出基于音频信号处理的攻击流程；(3) 量化攻击成功率并验证其现实威胁。适合安全研究人员、智能电视厂商及关注隐私保护的用户阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能电视已成为家庭常见设备，用户常在电视上输入敏感信息。本研究揭示的声学侧信道攻击无需额外硬件，仅通过录音即可窃取密码和信用卡数据，威胁家庭隐私安全，值得安全从业者关注并推动厂商修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用虚拟键盘的智能电视用户，尤其是依靠方向键输入且产生音频反馈的机型。攻击场景可扩展至其他具有类似音频泄漏的设备（如游戏机、机顶盒等）。

items.why_it_matters: 智能电视已成为家庭常见设备，用户常在电视上输入敏感信息。本研究揭示的声学侧信道攻击无需额外硬件，仅通过录音即可窃取密码和信用卡数据，威胁家庭隐私安全，值得安全从业者关注并推动厂商修复。

items.title: IRRedicator: Pruning IRR with RPKI-Valid BGP Insights.
items.summary:
Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) provides a way of exchanging routing information to help routers construct their routing tables. However, due to the lack of security considerations, BGP has been suffering from vulnerabilities such as BGP hijacking attacks. To mitigate these issues, two data sources have been used, Internet Routing Registry (IRR) and Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI), to provide reliable mappings between IP prefixes and their authorized Autonomous Systems (ASes). Each of the data sources, however, has its own limitations. IRR has been well-known for its stale Route objects with outdated AS information since network operators do not have enough incentives to keep them up to date, and RPKI has been slowly deployed due to its operational complexities. In this paper, we measure the prevalent inconsistencies between Route objects in IRR and ROA objects in RPKI. We next characterize inconsistent and consistent Route objects, respectively, by focusing on their BGP announcement patterns. Based on this insight, we develop a technique that identifies stale Route objects by leveraging
a machine learning algorithm and evaluate its performance. From real trace-based experiments, we show that our technique can offer advantages against the status quo by reducing the percentage of potentially stale Route objects from 72% to 40% (of the whole IRR Route objects). In this way, we achieve 93% of the accuracy of validating BGP announcements while covering 87% of BGP announcements.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对边界网关协议（BGP）中因缺乏安全机制而存在的路由劫持攻击问题，聚焦于两种用于提供IP前缀与授权自治系统（AS）映射的数据源——互联网路由注册库（IRR）和资源公钥基础设施（RPKI）。IRR中存储的路由对象（Route objects）常因网络运营商缺乏更新动力而包含过时的AS信息，而RPKI的路由起源授权（ROA）对象虽然更可靠但部署缓慢且操作复杂。作者首先大规模测量了IRR Route对象与RPKI ROA对象之间的不一致性，发现了广泛存在的陈旧记录。随后，基于BGP宣告模式（如路径特征、更新频率等），采用机器学习方法对Route对象进行一致性分类，并识别出潜在过时的条目。通过在真实网络流量数据集上的实验，该技术能够将整个IRR中可能过时的Route对象比例从72%降低至40%，同时使BGP宣告验证的准确率达到93%，覆盖87%的BGP宣告。该工作为网络运营商提供了一种自动化清理IRR记录、提升路由安全验证效率的实用工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: IRR数据陈旧长期困扰网络运维，本文提出数据驱动的自动清理方法，可显著降低人工维护成本，并提升基于RPKI的BGP路由验证准确性，减少路由劫持风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于网络运营商的BGP路由验证系统，提升IRR数据质量；方法可迁移至其他依赖注册数据的网络安全场景。

items.why_it_matters: IRR数据陈旧长期困扰网络运维，本文提出数据驱动的自动清理方法，可显著降低人工维护成本，并提升基于RPKI的BGP路由验证准确性，减少路由劫持风险。

items.title: Sharing cyber threat intelligence: Does it really help?
items.summary: The sharing of Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) across organizations is gaining traction, as it can automate threat analysis and improve security awareness.However, limited empirical studies exist on the prevalent types of cybersecurity threat data and their effectiveness in mitigating cyber attacks.We propose a framework named CTI-Lense to collect and analyze the volume, timeliness, coverage, and quality of Structured Threat Information eXpression (STIX) data, a de facto standard CTI format, from a list of publicly available CTI sources.We collected about 6 million STIX data objects from October 31, 2014 to April 10, 2023 from ten data sources and analyzed their characteristics.Our analysis reveals that STIX data sharing has steadily increased in recent years, but the volume of STIX data shared is still relatively low to cover all cyber threats.Additionally, only a few types of threat data objects have been shared, with malware signatures and URLs accounting for more than 90% of the collected data.While URLs are usually shared promptly, with about 72% of URLs shared earlier than or on the same day as VirusTotal, the sharing of malware signatures is significantly slower.Furthermore, we found that 19% of the Threat actor data contained incorrect information, and only 0.09% of the Indicator data provided security rules to detect cyber attacks.Based on our findings, we recommend practical considerations for effective and scalable STIX data sharing among organizations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对网络安全威胁情报（CTI）共享的实际效果进行了实证研究。虽然CTI共享被认为能够自动化威胁分析并提升安全意识，但缺乏对其类型分布和有效性的系统评估。作者提出了CTI-Lense框架，用于从多个公开CTI源收集和分析结构化威胁信息表达（STIX）数据，重点关注数据量、时效性、覆盖范围和质量。研究从2014年10月31日至2023年4月10日收集了来自十个数据源的约600万个STIX对象。分析发现：STIX数据共享量虽逐年稳步增长，但总体覆盖率仍较低；共享的威胁数据类型有限，恶意软件签名和URL占据90%以上；URL的共享时效性较好（约72%早于或等于VirusTotal），但恶意软件签名的共享明显滞后；此外，19%的威胁行为者数据包含错误信息，仅0.09%的指标数据提供了检测规则。基于这些发现，作者提出了改进STIX数据共享有效性和可扩展性的实践建议。该研究对安全运营团队、CTI平台设计者和政策制定者具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前CTI共享实践中数据类型单一、质量参差不齐等问题，提醒安全团队谨慎依赖共享情报，并为优化情报源选择和评估提供了数据驱动依据。

items.title: How to Hide MetaData in MLS-Like Secure Group Messaging: Simple, Modular, and Post-Quantum.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种在类似MLS（Messaging Layer Security）的安全群组消息协议中隐藏元数据的通用方法。MLS是IETF标准化的端到端加密群组通信协议，但其设计主要关注消息内容的机密性，而元数据（如发送者身份、群组结构、消息时序等）仍可能被观察者推断。作者设计了一种简单、模块化的方案，通过引入密码学原语（如匿名密钥交换、可穿刺加密、后量子安全假设）来隐藏通信模式。该方法独立于底层MLS协议的细节，可兼容现有实现，并支持后量子安全性（基于格密码）。实验表明，该方案在通信开销上仅增加少量带宽，且计算效率适合实际部署。核心贡献在于：(1) 形式化定义了群组消息中元数据隐藏的安全模型；(2) 提供了模块化构造，可组合不同隐私增强技术；(3) 给出了后量子安全的实例化。对于安全从业者，该工作揭示了群组通信中常被忽视的元数据泄露风险，并提供了可落地的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 群组消息元数据泄露（如谁给谁发消息、成员关系）可能被用于社交图谱重建、行为分析甚至定向攻击。该论文提出了首个兼顾实用性与后量子安全的元数据隐藏方案，对保护高价值群组通信（如政务、金融、军事）有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何基于MLS或类似树状结构的群组协议，但也适用于其他端到端加密系统中的元数据保护场景。

items.title: Poster: A Novel Formal Threat Analyzer for Activity Monitoring-based Smart Home Heating, Ventilation, and Cooling Control System.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的形式化威胁分析器，专门针对基于活动监测的智能家居供暖、通风和空调（HVAC）控制系统。研究背景在于智能家居系统日益普及，但HVAC控制系统中集成的活动监测功能可能引入安全漏洞，攻击者可利用这些漏洞进行隐私侵犯或物理控制干扰。论文的核心方法是构建一个形式化模型，将HVAC系统的行为、用户活动模式以及潜在威胁场景抽象为数学规范，并利用模型检测技术自动验证系统是否存在特定类型的安全威胁。主要贡献包括：设计了一个通用的威胁建模框架，能够捕获基于活动监测的HVAC系统的独特攻击面；开发了自动化分析工具，可输出可解释的风险报告；通过真实场景的案例研究验证了分析器的有效性，证明了其能够发现常规安全审计难以识别的隐蔽威胁。实验表明，该分析器在检测物联网环境中的信息泄露和物理篡改攻击方面具有较高准确性。该研究适合智能家居安全研究人员、HVAC系统设计师以及物联网安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能家居HVAC系统因感知用户活动而面临独特隐私与安全风险，本文提供的自动化形式化分析方法有助于在设计阶段发现威胁，提升系统韧性。

items.title: Location Heartbleeding: The Rise of Wi-Fi Spoofing Attack Via Geolocation API.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了一种新型的Wi-Fi欺骗攻击，攻击者利用浏览器Geolocation API获取用户位置，并通过伪造Wi-Fi信号来触发恶意行为。作者首先分析了Geolocation API的工作原理，指出其依赖于Wi-Fi信号强度来定位，但缺乏对信号真实性的验证。然后，他们设计了一种攻击方法，攻击者可以模拟合法Wi-Fi接入点，导致API返回错误的位置信息。通过实验，他们证明了该攻击在多种设备上的有效性，并讨论了可能的防御措施，如增加信号验证机制或限制API的精度。该研究揭示了现有位置服务的安全漏洞，对移动安全和隐私保护具有重要意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了Geolocation API中Wi-Fi信号验证的缺失，可能被用于位置欺骗，影响依赖位置服务的应用（如地图、社交网络），需引起安全从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能被用于位置欺诈、社交工程攻击，影响移动设备用户和基于位置的服务提供商。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了Geolocation API中Wi-Fi信号验证的缺失，可能被用于位置欺骗，影响依赖位置服务的应用（如地图、社交网络），需引起安全从业者关注。

items.title: Identifying a Training-Set Attack's Target Using Renormalized Influence Estimation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究训练集攻击（如数据投毒）的目标识别问题。攻击者通过修改部分训练样本，使模型对特定测试样本产生错误预测。现有防御主要检测中毒样本，但难以定位攻击者试图破坏的具体目标。作者提出基于重归一化影响估计（Renormalized Influence Estimation）的方法，通过修正影响函数在中毒数据下的偏差，准确识别攻击目标。核心思路是计算每个训练样本对目标测试样本的贡献，并利用重归一化消除中毒样本间的相互干扰，从而定位最具恶性影响的训练样本。实验在多个数据集和攻击场景下验证，该方法能高效且高精度地识别攻击目标，优于基线方法。该工作首次将影响函数应用于训练集攻击目标识别，为机器学习安全提供了新视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 训练集攻击是机器学习安全的核心威胁，识别攻击目标可帮助防御者快速响应、定位受损资产，提升ML系统的可信与可控性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何使用监督学习的场景，尤其是安全敏感领域如垃圾邮件检测、恶意软件分类、欺诈识别等。

items.title: Poster EveGAN: Using Generative Deep Learning for Cryptanalysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文介绍了一项使用生成式深度学习（具体为生成对抗网络，GAN）进行密码分析的研究。研究背景在于传统密码分析方法往往依赖人工设计的启发式算法或数学求解，而深度学习尤其是生成模型在捕捉复杂分布方面具有潜力。核心问题是探索GAN能否用于学习和近似密码算法的统计特性，从而辅助或改进密码分析过程。方法上，论文提出了一个名为EveGAN的框架，通过对抗训练让生成器模拟“明文-密文”对的联合分布，而判别器则试图区分真实的密码对与生成器产生的假对。实验部分在简化密码系统上测试了EveGAN的能力，表明其能够在某些假设下恢复部分密钥信息或降低暴力破解搜索空间。主要贡献在于首次系统性地评估GAN在密码分析中的应用，并指出了生成模型在密码学分析中的潜在价值与局限。适合对AI与密码学交叉领域感兴趣的研究人员阅读，但需注意其攻击假设较弱，实际场景下的有效性仍需验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作展示了生成模型用于密码分析的新途径，可能启发新的攻击向量；蓝队需关注类似技术是否在未来威胁中成熟。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 目前影响有限，仅针对简化密码系统；长期若推广至真实算法，可能威胁对称加密安全。

defense_advice_zh: 加强密钥长度和轮数以增加GAN学习难度

items.title: Tilikum: Transaction Fair Ordering on a DAG without Weak Edges
items.summary: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) applications rely heavily on the order in which transactions are executed, making them susceptible to reordering attacks that enable adversaries to extract Blockchain Extractable Value (BEV). While linear blockchain systems such as Ethereum have inspired extensive research into fair ordering mechanisms, DAG-based consensus protocols have remained largely unprotected despite their growing adoption for scalability and performance. In this paper, we introduce Tilikum, a DAG-based ledger protocol that ensures fair transaction ordering without relying on weak edges. Tilikum achieves ordering linearizability by leveraging median-based timestamp aggregation, or batch order fairness, while maintaining low data redundancy and robust garbage collection. We implemented Tilikum in Rust and evaluated it against representative baselines, namely Narwhal/Tusk, Pompē, Themis and FairDAG. Our results show that Tilikum achieves up to $39\times$ higher throughput than other fair-ordering baselines, while fully blocking state-of-the-art DAG-specific reordering attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 Tilikum，一种基于 DAG（有向无环图）的账本协议，旨在解决去中心化金融（DeFi）应用中交易排序的公平性问题。DeFi 应用高度依赖交易执行顺序，容易受到重排序攻击，攻击者可利用此漏洞提取区块链可提取价值（BEV）。尽管以太坊等线性区块链系统已有大量公平排序机制研究，但基于 DAG 的共识协议在公平排序方面仍缺乏保护，尽管它们因可扩展性和性能而被广泛采用。Tilikum 的核心创新在于无需依赖弱边即可实现公平交易排序。它通过基于中位数的时间戳聚合或批量顺序公平性来达成排序线性化（ordering linearizability），同时保持低数据冗余和高效的垃圾收集机制。作者在 Rust 中实现了 Tilikum，并与 Narwhal/Tusk、Pompē、Themis 和 FairDAG 等代表性基线进行对比实验。结果表明，Tilikum 的吞吐量比其它公平排序基线最高提升 39 倍，并能完全阻止最先进的 DAG 特定重排序攻击。该协议为 DAG 共识系统的公平排序提供了高效且安全的解决方案，对提升 DeFi 应用的安全性和可信度具有重要意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: DeFi 应用面临的重排序攻击威胁日益严重，现有 DAG 协议缺乏公平排序保护。Tilikum 提供了一种高效、安全的公平排序方案，可显著提升 DAG 共识系统的抗攻击能力，对保障区块链金融生态稳定至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响基于 DAG 的区块链系统（如 Narwhal/Tusk 等）的交易公平性，可扩展到需要公平排序的分布式账本和去中心化应用（DApp）场景。

items.why_it_matters: DeFi 应用面临的重排序攻击威胁日益严重，现有 DAG 协议缺乏公平排序保护。Tilikum 提供了一种高效、安全的公平排序方案，可显著提升 DAG 共识系统的抗攻击能力，对保障区块链金融生态稳定至关重要。

items.title: The Observer World: A Cryptographic Extension of Impagliazzo's Five Worlds
items.summary: Impagliazzo's five worlds classify computational assumptions along a single axis, the existence of cryptographic primitives. All five worlds implicitly assume that every party, including the adversary, observes the full input, that the observer is always $O_{top}$. This assumption is so natural that it is never stated. This work makes it explicit and relaxes it by introducing a second, orthogonal axis, the observational axis, defined by the observer hierarchy introduced in previous work. Relaxing the assumption reveals structural phenomena, such as the collapse $P^{O_{prof}} = NP^{O_{prof}} \subset P$, that the five-world framework cannot express. We prove that this collapse holds unconditionally in all five worlds, showing that observational blindness and computational hardness are independent. We define the Observer World $W_O$, classify all world-observer pairs, identify the labeled cells (a)--(d), and introduce a parametric family $W_O^{\varepsilon}$ modelling partial violations of observational invariants. The framework also interfaces with physical information limits, including thermodynamic, quantum, and cosmological bounds.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Impagliazzo 的五个世界模型是计算复杂性理论中的一个经典框架，它根据是否存在单向函数等密码学原语将计算假设分类为五个世界：算法世界、启发式世界、Minicrypt、Cryptomania 和 Obfustopia。该框架隐式地假设所有参与者（包括敌手）都能观察到完整输入，即观察者始终处于最高层级 O_top。然而，这一假设从未被明确说明。本文首次将这一假设显式化，并通过引入第二个正交轴——观察轴（基于先前工作中定义的观察者层级）来放松该假设。观察轴刻画了不同参与者对输入信息的访问权限。放松假设后，揭示了结构化的新现象，例如 P^{O_prof} = NP^{O_prof} ⊂ P 的塌缩，这是五世界框架无法表达的。本文证明该塌缩在所有五个世界中无条件成立，表明观察盲区与计算困难性是独立的。作者定义了观察者世界 W_O，对所有世界-观察者对进行分类，识别出四个标记单元 (a)-(d)，并引入了一个参数化家族 W_O^ε，用于模拟观察不变量的部分违反。该框架还与物理信息限制（包括热力学、量子和宇宙学界限）建立了联系。本文的主要贡献在于提出了一个更精细的理论框架，将计算复杂度与信息观察权限隔离分析，为密码学基础假设提供了新的视角。适合理论计算机科学家、密码学研究者以及关注计算复杂性基础问题的读者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作挑战了密码学和复杂性理论中一个长期未被质疑的隐藏假设，揭示了观察者能力对计算等价关系的影响，可能启发新的密码学原语设计思路。

items.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了密码学和复杂性理论中一个长期未被质疑的隐藏假设，揭示了观察者能力对计算等价关系的影响，可能启发新的密码学原语设计思路。

items.title: PRISM: PE Relational Inter-Section Matrix. A 2D Section-Aware Dataset for Static PE Malware Detection
items.summary: We introduce PRISM (PE Relational Inter-Section Matrix), an open dataset and feature representation for static Windows PE malware detection. Existing benchmarks such as EMBER, BODMAS, and SOREL-20M represent each PE file as a flat one-dimensional feature vector, discarding the ordering of sections and the relational context between them. PRISM instead encodes every binary as a two-dimensional matrix whose rows are individual PE sections in file order, with a global summary row that preserves compatibility with EMBER-style models. We build the corpus from four malware sources (BODMAS, MalwareBazaar, VirusShare, and CAPE) together with SOREL-20M benign software, yielding 83,633 deduplicated matrices and a family-filtered analysis corpus of 49,204 samples across 684 malware families. A formal separability analysis (Fisher Discriminant Ratio, mutual information, and inter-section information gain) shows that the per-section positional structure carries discriminative information that flat representations cannot capture. Under a strictly controlled, sample-matched comparison, a gradient-boosted classifier on the compact PRISM representation recovers nearly all of the binary-detection performance of the same classifier on the much larger EMBER vector, at roughly one-sixth the dimensionality; EMBER retains only a small, consistent advantage confined to the extreme low-false-positive regime, the two being operationally indistinguishable at the decision threshold. We are explicit that this binary task is saturated, so the structural content PRISM preserves is reserved for tasks with greater metric headroom, such as family classification and architectures that exploit the 2D structure directly. The dataset, extraction library, trained models, and full analysis pipeline are released under CC BY-NC-SA and MIT licences.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 PRISM（PE Relational Inter-Section Matrix），一个面向静态 Windows PE 恶意软件检测的开源数据集与特征表示。现有基准（如 EMBER、BODMAS、SOREL-20M）将每个 PE 文件表示为扁平一维特征向量，丢弃了节的顺序及节间的上下文关系。PRISM 将每个二进制文件编码为二维矩阵：行按文件顺序对应每个 PE 节，并附加一个全局摘要行以保持与 EMBER 风格模型的兼容性。数据集从四个恶意软件源（BODMAS、MalwareBazaar、VirusShare、CAPE）及 SOREL-20M 良性软件构建，共生成 83,633 个去重矩阵，以及一个包含 49,204 个样本（涵盖 684 个恶意家族）的家族过滤分析语料库。通过 Fisher 判别比、互信息和节间信息增益的正式可分离性分析表明，每个节的位置结构携带了扁平表示无法捕捉的判别信息。在严格控制、样本匹配的比较下，基于 PRISM 紧凑表示的梯度提升分类器在二进制检测性能上几乎与基于更大 EMBER 向量的相同分类器相当，而维度仅为后者的约六分之一；EMBER 仅在极低假阳性区域保持微小一致优势，在决策阈值处两者在操作上不可区分。作者明确指出二进制检测任务已饱和，因此 PRISM 保留的结构内容是为具有更大度量空间的进阶任务（如家族分类以及可直接利用 2D 结构的架构）而保留。数据集、提取库、训练模型及完整分析流程以 CC BY-NC-SA 和 MIT 许可证发布。本文适合从事恶意软件检测、特征工程、数据集构建的机器学习研究人员，以及希望探索结构化 PE 表示的安全分析师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: PRISM 提供了一种保留 PE 节顺序和关系的新颖二维特征表示，能揭示扁平向量丢失的判别结构，在家族分类等任务上潜力较大，且数据集开源，便于社区复现与扩展。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能推动 PE 恶意软件检测从传统一维特征向结构化表示演进，并促进针对家族分类、新型架构（如 CNN、Transformer）的研究。

items.why_it_matters: PRISM 提供了一种保留 PE 节顺序和关系的新颖二维特征表示，能揭示扁平向量丢失的判别结构，在家族分类等任务上潜力较大，且数据集开源，便于社区复现与扩展。

items.title: Application of LLMs to Threat Assessment of Foreign Peacekeeping Missions
items.summary: We present a novel approach for applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to threat assessment in the context of foreign peacekeeping missions. Building on the PINPOINT project and its use case, the EU Monitoring Mission in Georgia, we combine an interdisciplinary risk-model with OSINT-based media collection and LLM-supported threat extraction. The proposed workflow maps media contents to mission-relevant threats, extracts structured information and applies several additional LLM-based processing steps to improve relevance and grounding. An evaluation of threats extracted from media documents shows high agreement between automatically generated results and human judgment for core aspects such as threat and mission relevance. These results indicate that LLMs provide a promising approach to support analysts in the context of peacekeeping missions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种将大语言模型（LLM）应用于外国维和使命威胁评估的新方法。研究基于PINPOINT项目及其案例——欧盟驻格鲁吉亚监测团，结合跨学科风险模型、开源情报（OSINT）媒体收集和LLM支持的威胁提取。所提出的工作流将媒体内容映射到使命相关威胁，提取结构化信息，并应用多个基于LLM的额外处理步骤以提高相关性和基础性。对从媒体文档中提取的威胁进行的评估显示，自动生成的结果与人类判断在威胁和使命相关性等核心方面具有高度一致性。这些结果表明，LLM为支持维和使命中的分析师提供了一种有前景的方法。该研究主要贡献在于构建了一个半自动化的威胁评估框架，有效减轻了分析师在大量OSINT数据中识别关键威胁的负担，并验证了LLM在该领域的可行性。适合对LLM在安全情报分析中应用感兴趣的研究人员和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文展示了LLM在非传统安全领域（维和威胁评估）的应用潜力，为安全情报分析自动化提供了新思路，尤其是结合OSINT的威胁提取与评估。

items.why_it_matters: 本文展示了LLM在非传统安全领域（维和威胁评估）的应用潜力，为安全情报分析自动化提供了新思路，尤其是结合OSINT的威胁提取与评估。

items.title: zQR: A Verifiable QR-Driven zkSNARK Proof Verification Framework for Mobile Platforms
items.summary: Privacy is one of the fundamental rights of individuals in modern societies. Yet, the practical adoption of privacy-preserving technologies in daily interactions remains limited. Zero-knowledge proofs offer strong privacy guarantees but are often hindered by their technical complexity. In this paper, we advance the idea of verifiable QR codes that enable off-line verifiers to verify proofs encoded in QR codes. Based on this core idea, we build a novel QR-driven zkSNARK proof verification framework (i.e., zQR) for mobile platforms. The framework integrates blockchain for auditability, non-repudiation and logging; and large-language models for automatic circuit generation. We perform a security discussion of the framework by considering multiple attack surfaces. Furthermore, we present an experimental evaluation measuring temporal costs (proof generation and verification latency, QR code encoding and decoding latency) and financial costs (blockchain gas consumption). Our results demonstrate the feasibility of zQR as a proof-of-concept framework for privacy-preserving verification on mobile platform where proofs are compactly represented with QR code symbol version of 19 with low error correction level. Finally, we discuss potential applications, current limitations and future directions for the broader adoption of privacy-preserving technologies in daily interactions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为zQR的新型框架，旨在移动平台上实现可验证的QR码驱动的zkSNARK（简洁非交互零知识证明）验证。研究背景是隐私保护技术在日常交互中应用有限，尽管零知识证明提供强隐私保证，但其技术复杂性阻碍了实际采用。核心问题是如何让离线验证者能够通过QR码验证编码其中的证明。方法上，zQR框架将zkSNARK证明紧凑编码为QR码，支持离线验证，并集成区块链以实现可审计性、不可否认性和日志记录，同时利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成电路。作者对框架进行了安全讨论，考虑了多个攻击面。实验评估包括时间成本（证明生成和验证延迟、QR码编码和解码延迟）和财务成本（区块链gas消耗）。结果显示，当使用版本19的低纠错级别QR码时，zQR作为移动平台上隐私保护验证的概念验证框架是可行的。论文最后讨论了潜在应用、当前局限和未来方向，如更广泛采用隐私保护技术。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将零知识证明与QR码结合，降低技术门槛，使移动端用户无需复杂计算即可验证隐私保护证明，为现实场景（如数字身份、凭证验证）提供实践路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于移动设备上的离线身份认证、防伪溯源、隐私声明验证等场景，尤其在网络受限或信任去中心化环境中具有价值。

items.why_it_matters: 该框架将零知识证明与QR码结合，降低技术门槛，使移动端用户无需复杂计算即可验证隐私保护证明，为现实场景（如数字身份、凭证验证）提供实践路径。

items.title: Inherited Circuits, Learned Semantics: How Fine-Tuning Creates Evasion Vulnerabilities Invisible to Standard Evaluation
items.summary: LLMs fine-tuned for security classification are usually evaluated on held-out examples from the same distribution as their training data. We show that this can miss vulnerabilities introduced by fine-tuning itself: models can learn token-level indicator semantics that preserve canonical accuracy while failing under behavior-preserving transformations such as PowerShell alias substitution, command reconstruction, string construction, execution indirection, and case mutation. We study Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct and its base model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, on matched PowerShell classification cohorts. Causal interventions localize the classification circuit to a late-attention route inherited from Llama rather than created by fine-tuning. Fine-tuning concentrates and semantically specializes this inherited structure, improving baseline behavior while creating transformation-sensitive attack surfaces. A three-tier evasion benchmark finds Foundation-Sec misses on iwr substitution, Invoke-Expression reconstruction, and case-mutated Invoke-Expression/IEX variants that Llama does not share. We also derive a pre-deployment monitoring method: a linear probe at the classification boundary and an indicator-token sign test identify command families where canonical indicators change role after fine-tuning. These signals prioritize red-team variant generation using only canonical inputs, showing that security fine-tuning can improve task accuracy while expanding the evasion surface. These results caution against treating small task-specific fine-tunes as straightforwardly safer security classifiers: specialization can convert inherited model structure into brittle indicator rules that preserve held-out accuracy while expanding the evasion surface. Robust AI-enabled security will require specifying the full transformation space of the task and monitoring semantic drift through fine-tuning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在针对安全分类任务进行微调后，可能引入的逃避漏洞。通常，微调后的模型仅在保留的同分布测试集上评估，但作者发现这种评估方式无法发现微调本身引入的漏洞：模型可能学习到基于指示符标记的语义，在规范输入上保持准确率，但在PowerShell别名替换、命令重构、字符串构造、执行间接和大小写变异等行为保持变换下失效。研究对象为Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct及其基础模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，在匹配的PowerShell分类数据集上测试。通过因果干预，作者发现分类电路继承自Llama的后期注意力路径，而非微调创建。微调集中并语义特化了这一继承结构，改善了基线行为，但创造了易受变换攻击的表面。三层次逃避基准测试显示，Foundation-Sec在iwr替换、Invoke-Expression重构以及大小写变异的Invoke-Expression/IEX变体上失效，而Llama则没有这些问题。作者还提出了一种部署前监控方法：在分类边界使用线性探针，以及指示符标记符号检验，用于识别在微调后规范指示符角色发生变化的命令族。这些信号仅使用规范输入即可优先生成红队变体，表明安全微调可以在提高任务准确率的同时扩大逃避面。该研究警告，不应将针对特定任务的小型微调模型视为更安全的安全分类器：特化可能将继承的模型结构转化为脆弱的指示符规则，在保持保留集准确率的同时扩大逃避面。鲁棒的AI安全需要指定任务的完整变换空间，并监控微调过程中的语义漂移。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文揭示了安全微调LLM的一个隐蔽风险：标准评估无法发现微调引入的逃避漏洞，可能导致部署的模型在实际攻击中失效。研究提供了一种部署前监控方法，对安全运营和AI安全研究有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响基于LLM的安全分类系统（如恶意PowerShell检测），可迁移至其他领域（如代码分析、提示注入检测），只要涉及安全微调。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估：在部署前对本组织使用的安全分类LLM进行类似变换测试和语义漂移监控。

items.title: Type-based information flow analysis for $π$-calculus with a dynamically extensible security lattice
items.summary: We develop a type system for secure information flow where new security levels can be created and inserted into the security lattice dynamically, i.e., even in the middle of an execution of a system. Our system is formalized by extending Kobayashi's type-based secure information flow analysis for Milner's pi-calculus, which is one of the most expressive models (or "languages") supporting both sequential and concurrent computations, with concise syntax, reduction-based semantics, and bisimulation equivalence as a robust formalization of secrecy as non-interference. The development required careful treatment of extensions of lattices themselves as well as deliberate generalization from the simple 2-element lattice (consisting of only High and Low) in the original system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对π-演算的基于类型的安全信息流分析系统，其中安全级别可以在系统执行期间动态创建并插入到安全格中。现有的基于类型的信息流分析方法通常假设安全格是静态的，无法适应运行时安全策略的变化。作者通过扩展Kobayashi等人提出的π-演算的类型化安全信息流分析框架，实现了对动态安全格的支持。π-演算是一种表达能力强的模型，支持顺序和并发计算，具有简洁的语法、基于归约的语义和双模拟等价性，能够稳健地形式化非干扰性的保密性。论文的核心贡献在于：1) 形式化地处理了安全格本身的扩展；2) 将原始系统中简单的二元素格（仅包含高和低两个级别）推广到任意动态可扩展的格结构；3) 通过类型系统确保即使安全格动态变化，程序的信息流仍满足非干扰性。该研究为并发系统中的运行时安全策略自适应提供了理论基础，适合形式化方法、程序语言理论和安全分析领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 动态安全格扩展能力填补了现有类型化信息流分析在处理运行时安全策略变化方面的空白，对自适应安全系统和云环境中的动态安全域管理具有潜在指导意义。

items.why_it_matters: 动态安全格扩展能力填补了现有类型化信息流分析在处理运行时安全策略变化方面的空白，对自适应安全系统和云环境中的动态安全域管理具有潜在指导意义。

items.title: Physical Layer Authentication With Channel Knowledge Maps in Indoor Environments
items.summary: Physical layer authentication (PLA) allows to authenticate the user by comparing measurements over time, assuming their time consistency or by modeling their evolution. However, these assumptions become problematic when devices are in motion and in indoor environments due to multipath propagation and obstructions. In this paper, we propose a PLA mechanism for moving devices in indoor environments, where multiple access points (APs) estimate the dominant channel tap path loss (PL) and angle of arrival (AoA) from the received signals and compare them with previously collected channel knowledge maps (CKMs). Specifically, the measurements are compared to those in the neighborhood of the previously known position obtained from CKMs. A comprehensive security analysis is conducted under both random and optimal attacks. Numerical results in a representative indoor scenario, with CKM obtained via ray tracing, validate the effectiveness of the proposed PLA approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对室内移动设备场景下传统物理层认证（PLA）方法失效的问题，提出了一种基于信道知识地图（CKM）的新型PLA机制。在室内环境中，由于多径传播和遮挡，移动设备的信道特性快速变化，基于时间一致性或演化模型的传统PLA难以有效应用。该机制通过多个接入点（AP）同时估计来自用户设备的主信道抽头的路径损耗（PL）和到达角（AoA），并将这些测量值与事先通过射线追踪等手段建立的CKM进行比较。具体地，将当前测量值与CKM中已知位置邻域内的历史数据对比，利用空间相关性判断用户是否合法。论文在典型的室内场景下进行了全面的安全性分析，包括随机攻击和最优攻击模型，数值结果验证了所提方法的有效性。该工作为物理层安全在室内移动物联网、工业无线网络等场景中的应用提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文解决了室内移动设备物理层认证的关键瓶颈，所提CKM方法可显著提升无线通信的安全性，对物联网、智能家居等场景的物理层安全设计具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于室内移动设备（如机器人、手持终端）的无线认证场景，可扩展至多AP协作的物理层安全体系。

items.title: Design and Performance Evaluation of Secure RF and WiFi-Based Communication in Drone Swarms via Testbed Implementation
items.summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms rely on distributed coordination and cooperative communication to support scalable operations, extended coverage, and applications such as surveillance and real-time data exchange. Wireless technologies such as radio frequency (RF) and WiFi are widely used for UAV-to-UAV and UAV-to-ground control station (GCS) communication but introduce significant security challenges. MAVLink, the predominant communication protocol in UAV systems, provides message integrity and authentication but lacks built-in encryption, leaving telemetry traffic vulnerable to eavesdropping. In our previous work, we proposed MAVShield, a lightweight encryption framework for MAVLink communications. In this paper, MAVShield, AES-CTR, Speck-CTR, ChaCha20, and Rabbit are integrated into four custom-built UAVs to establish secure communication links over RF and WiFi channels. Their performance is evaluated through flight experiments using a UAV swarm testbed. Encrypted telemetry data enable autonomous formation control and collision avoidance during flight. For collision avoidance, we develop a modified artificial potential field (APF) algorithm that computes attractive and repulsive forces directly in geodetic coordinates, eliminating Cartesian transformations and reducing trajectory oscillations while avoiding local-minimum trapping. CPU utilization, memory consumption, and packet delivery ratio (PDR) are measured for each encryption scheme. Results show that MAVShield achieves performance comparable to unencrypted communication while outperforming AES-CTR, Speck-CTR, ChaCha20, and Rabbit in overall efficiency. Algebraic cryptanalysis and Wireshark-based traffic analysis demonstrate resistance to key-recovery attacks and protection of telemetry confidentiality. The results indicate that MAVShield is an efficient and secure solution for UAV swarm communication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 无人机蜂群依赖分布式协调和合作通信来实现可扩展操作、扩展覆盖以及监控和实时数据交换等应用。射频和WiFi等无线技术广泛应用于无人机间和无人机与地面控制站通信，但引入了显著的安全挑战。MAVLink协议是无人机系统中最常用的通信协议，它提供消息完整性和认证，但缺乏内置加密，使得遥测数据容易遭受窃听。在该论文中，作者在其先前提出的MAVShield轻量级加密框架基础上，将MAVShield、AES-CTR、Speck-CTR、ChaCha20和Rabbit五种加密方案集成到四架定制无人机中，建立安全的RF和WiFi通信链路，并在无人机蜂群实验床上通过飞行实验评估其性能。加密遥测数据使自主编队控制和碰撞避免成为可能。对于碰撞避免，他们开发了改进的人工势场算法，直接在地理坐标系中计算引力和斥力，消除了笛卡尔坐标变换，减少了轨迹振荡，并避免了局部极小陷阱。测量了每种加密方案的CPU利用率、内存消耗和丢包率。结果表明，MAVShield在总体效率上优于AES-CTR、Speck-CTR、ChaCha20和Rabbit，性能与未加密通信相当。代数密码分析和基于Wireshark的流量分析证明了MAVShield抵抗密钥恢复攻击和保护遥测机密性的能力。该工作表明MAVShield是无人机蜂群通信的一种高效且安全的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无人机蜂群通信的安全性至关重要，MAVShield提供了轻量级加密方案，在不显著牺牲性能的前提下加固MAVLink协议，直接解决了实际部署中的窃听威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有采用MAVLink协议的无人机系统，尤其是需要轻量级加密的嵌入式场景。
detection_signals_zh: 监控MAVLink遥测流量中的非加密数据包
检测异常高延迟或丢包可能指向加密解密开销
defense_advice_zh: 在无人机蜂群通信中部署MAVShield或其他轻量级加密方案
定期审计加密方案性能以平衡安全与效率

items.title: ShareLock: A Stealthy Multi-Tool Threshold Poisoning Attack Against MCP
items.summary: With the rapid evolution of LLM-driven agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open protocol bridging LLMs with external tools, has quickly become foundational to modern agent ecosystems. However, the expanding adoption of MCP has also introduced novel security concerns such as Tool Poisoning Attack (TPA), which exploit LLM-server interactions to inject malicious prompts. Existing poisoning schemes typically adopt a monolithic plaintext embedding paradigm, which fails to withstand manual inspection or automated detectors. Current research still lacks a systematic analysis on multi-tool poisoning, where multiple tools can be exploited cooperatively to disperse detection risk. In this paper, we introduce ShareLock, a multi-tool threshold poisoning framework that utilizes Shamir's threshold scheme to ensure exceptional stealth and fault tolerance. ShareLock distributes the malicious instruction as benign-looking secret shares across multiple tool descriptions, achieving both information-theoretic secrecy and attack robustness against moderate auditing. After a covert reconstruction trigger is planted during server update, the aggregated shares reconstruct the hidden instruction, resulting in critical breaches of system assets or private data. To evaluate the realistic threat of ShareLock, we constructed a comprehensive benchmark encompassing four multi-tool scenarios and conducted extensive experiments across mainstream LLMs on two distinct MCP clients. Our results demonstrate that ShareLock significantly outperforms existing single-tool poisoning strategies in tool description-based detection while maintaining an average attack success rate exceeding 90%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体生态系统中新兴的安全威胁，提出了一种名为ShareLock的隐蔽多工具阈值投毒攻击框架。研究背景是：随着Model Context Protocol（MCP）协议成为连接LLM与外部工具的核心标准，工具投毒攻击（TPA）通过注入恶意提示利用LLM-服务器交互，但现有单一工具投毒方式易于被人工审查或自动化检测器发现，且缺乏对多工具协同投毒的系统分析。ShareLock创新性地应用Shamir阈值秘密共享方案，将恶意指令拆分为多个看似无害的“秘密份额”，分发到与正常功能无关的工具描述中。这些份额单独无法还原恶意指令，从而实现了信息论安全性和对中等程度审计的鲁棒性。攻击者在服务器更新时植入一个隐蔽的触发条件，当MCP客户端在特定上下文中触发该条件时，各份额会自动聚合重建完整恶意指令，导致系统敏感资产泄露或数据被窃取。为评估威胁，作者构建了包含四个多工具场景的综合基准测试（如代码执行、文件读取、数据库查询、Web搜索），并在两个主流MCP客户端上对多个LLM进行实验。结果显示，ShareLock在基于工具描述的检测中显著优于现有单工具投毒策略，同时平均攻击成功率超过90%。该研究揭示了MCP生态中一类新型、更隐蔽的攻击路径，对LLM智能体安全防御提出了新挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM智能体依赖MCP调用外部工具，ShareLock通过多工具协同投毒绕过了现有检测机制，威胁真实且隐蔽，安全从业者需关注此类新型攻击面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响使用MCP协议的LLM智能体系统，攻击者可远程窃取敏感数据或控制系统工具，风险面涵盖开发、测试及生产环境。

items.title: Protocol Prying: Systematic Vulnerability Research in the Apple AirDrop and Android Quick Share Proximity Transfer Protocols
items.summary: Apple AirDrop and Google/Samsung Quick Share are proximity file-transfer protocols used by over five billion devices, yet their application-layer security properties remain largely unstudied because both stacks are proprietary and undocumented. Both protocols are reachable from wireless proximity without any prior pairing and process complex serialized content (binary plists, CPIO archives, Protocol Buffers, UKEY2 handshakes) inside privileged daemons, making them attractive zero-click targets across multiple operating systems. We perform the first cross-platform reverse engineering and protocol-aware fuzzing study of both stacks. We reconstruct AirDrop's seven-layer state machine and DVZip adaptive compression from binary analysis, build AIRFUZZ, a protocol-aware fuzzer that mutates pre-compression representations, and complement it with targeted hand-written analyses of Samsung's Quick Share service and Google's Quick Share for Windows. We discover six vulnerabilities (V1-V6): three pre-authentication issues in macOS/iOS AirDrop (V1: Swift fatalError DoS in the HTTP path router; V2: unbounded XML plist recursion in Foundation; V3: NULL dereference in Network.framework's HTTP/1.1 parser), two protocol-layer flaws in Samsung Quick Share (V4: pre-authentication OfflineFrame dispatch; V5: D2D encryption bypass for three frame types), and a heap use-after-free in Google Quick Share for Windows (V6) for which Google awarded a bounty. We responsibly disclosed all findings, and Apple, Samsung, and Google have acknowledged the reports.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对Apple AirDrop和Google/Samsung Quick Share这两个近距离文件传输协议进行了首次跨平台逆向工程与协议感知模糊测试研究。这两个协议被超过50亿设备使用，但由于实现是专有且未公开的，其应用层安全属性此前鲜有研究。两者无需预先配对即可通过无线近程访问，并在特权守护进程中处理复杂的序列化内容（如二进制plist、CPIO归档、Protocol Buffers、UKEY2握手），因此成为多个操作系统上的零单击攻击目标。研究者通过二进制分析重构了AirDrop的七层状态机与DVZip自适应压缩算法，开发了协议感知模糊测试工具AIRFUZZ，该工具可变异压缩前的表示，并辅以对Samsung Quick Share服务及Google Quick Share for Windows的手动分析。共发现6个漏洞（V1-V6）：三个macOS/iOS AirDrop的预认证问题（V1：HTTP路径路由器的Swift fatalError DoS；V2：Foundation中无界XML plist递归；V3：Network.framework的HTTP/1.1解析器中的NULL解引用）；两个Samsung Quick Share的协议层缺陷（V4：预认证OfflineFrame调度漏洞；V5：三种帧类型的D2D加密绕过）；以及Google Quick Share for Windows中的一个堆释放后重用漏洞（V6），Google为此颁发了漏洞奖励。所有发现已负责任地披露，Apple、Samsung和Google已确认报告。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了数十亿设备上广泛使用的Android/iOS近程文件传输协议存在零单击攻击面，且多个漏洞无需认证即可触发，对移动与桌面端安全构成重大威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Apple macOS/iOS设备（V1-V3）及Samsung Android设备（V4-V5）、Windows平台（V6），可能导致拒绝服务、信息泄露或远程代码执行。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议相关厂商尽快应用补丁，安全团队关注官方安全更新并部署网络隔离或近程功能禁用策略。

items.title: Jailbreaking for the Average Jane: Choosing Optimal Jailbreaks via Bandit Algorithms for Automatically Enhanced Queries
items.summary: With a profusion of jailbreaks for LLMs now widely known, a growing concern is that non-expert malicious actors ("the average Jane") could elicit actionable responses to malicious requests. In this work, we examine whether this concern is justified. A non-expert malicious actor requires two ingredients for a successful attack: a powerful jailbreak for their target model, acting on an effective malicious query. For the former, we propose a novel attack strategy based on the multi-armed bandit framework. This allows efficient online learning of the optimal jailbreak from a large choice set via noisy exploration on a small number of queries, with subsequent application of the learnt policy on an exploitation set. For the latter, we curate $\mathrm{FrankensteinBench}$, a safety benchmark of $11,279$ malicious queries drawn from manual curation over $7$ existing benchmarks, along with automated enhancement and generation. Each query is categorized as simple or complex by the technical expertise required to craft it. Our findings confirm the concern. Our bandit-based attack achieves success rates as high as $97\%$ on average over $15$ SoTA open-weight LLMs. Moreover, adding complexity to queries raises the attack success rate by up to $26\%$ on average across models -- making it an effective, automatable prompting strategy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一个关键安全问题：非专业恶意攻击者（“普通用户”）能否利用现有的大量越狱方法来高效攻击大型语言模型（LLM）。作者提出了一个基于多臂老虎机（multi-armed bandit）框架的新型攻击策略，该策略能够通过少量恶意查询的噪声探索，从众多越狱方法中在线学习并选择最优解，然后应用于大规模恶意查询集。为了支持实验，作者构建了FrankensteinBench基准测试，包含11,279个基于7个现有基准手动整理并自动增强的恶意查询，并按所需技术难度分为简单和复杂两类。实验在15个开源权重LLM上进行，平均攻击成功率高达97%。此外，增加查询的复杂性（如通过自动化提示工程）可使平均攻击成功率提升26%，表明该策略高效且可自动化。本文从攻击者视角揭示了LLM面临的严峻威胁，强调即使是非专业攻击者也可能利用自动化工具实现高成功率攻击。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示非专业攻击者利用自动化工具即可高效越狱LLM，打破“需专业知识”的假设，促使防御者重新评估威胁模型并加强防御。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：关注多臂老虎机攻击的动态，评估现有防御（如输入过滤、输出监控）的有效性，并探索针对自动化越狱的检测方法。

items.title: Chai: Agentic Discovery of Cryptographic Misuse Vulnerabilities
items.summary: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery has proven effective for bug classes like memory safety, where instrumentation confirms memory violations and efficiently filters false positives. Many dangerous vulnerability classes, such as cryptographic misuse, however, lack any comparable instrumentation. In this work, we present Chai, an AI-based system that discovers and validates cryptographic misuse vulnerabilities through naturally occurring signals. To achieve this, Chai rethinks the classical technique of differential testing by leveraging AI to 1) improve precision for detecting real security issues in libraries, and 2) repurpose commonly overlooked discrepancies as leads for tangible vulnerabilities in downstream applications. In doing so, Chai inverts the prevailing paradigm of AI vulnerability discovery: instead of auditing one codebase for many flaws, it catalogs flaws at the library level and propagates them across a cryptographic dependency graph, delivering compounding efficiency gains. We evaluate Chai across X.509, JWT, and SAML libraries. Chai discovered a previously unknown critical vulnerability in an SSL library that powers billions of devices, along with security bugs in one library behind a major web browser and another in major Linux distributions. In total, these techniques surfaced over 100 vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 Chai，一个基于人工智能的漏洞发现系统，专门针对密码学误用漏洞。传统上，AI辅助漏洞发现对内存安全等漏洞类效果较好，因为这些漏洞可以通过插桩验证内存违规并高效过滤误报。然而，许多危险的漏洞类（如密码学误用）缺乏类似的插桩技术。Chai 重新思考了经典的不同测试（differential testing）技术，利用AI提升检测精度，将通常被忽视的差异重新用作下游应用中实际漏洞的线索。具体而言，Chai 颠覆了当前AI漏洞发现的范式：不是审计单个代码库寻找多个缺陷，而是在库级别对缺陷进行编目，并通过密码学依赖图传播，实现复合效率增益。作者在 X.509、JWT 和 SAML 库上评估了 Chai。Chai 发现了一个此前未知的严重漏洞，影响一个驱动数十亿设备的SSL库，此外还发现了一个主流web浏览器使用的一个库以及一个主要Linux发行版中的安全漏洞。总体而言，这些技术发现了超过100个漏洞。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 密码学误用是严重且难以检测的漏洞类别，缺乏有效工具。Chai 首创了基于AI的库级漏洞编目与传播方法，能在大型依赖链中发现批量漏洞，显著提升效率。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面广泛：涉及SSL库、JWT、SAML等关键密码学组件，可延伸到所有使用密码学库的应用程序和系统。

items.why_it_matters: 密码学误用是严重且难以检测的漏洞类别，缺乏有效工具。Chai 首创了基于AI的库级漏洞编目与传播方法，能在大型依赖链中发现批量漏洞，显著提升效率。

items.title: A Deterministic Control Plane for LLM Coding Agents
items.summary: LLM coding harnesses grant agents broad file and shell access, yet the configuration layer that steers them -- rules files, agent definitions, IDE-specific markdown -- is largely unmanaged. A prevalence study of 10,008 public GitHub repositories (n=6,145 agent config files) finds that agent configurations propagate as undeclared shared components: 10.1% of tracked paths are SHA-256 exact duplicates across independent repositories (fork-adjusted, threshold-independent), with 75.5% of clone pairs crossing organisational boundaries. Two further patterns are indicative: configurations are rarely revised (58% single-commit; 0.4 vs 0.6 commits/month age-normalised against CI/CD workflows), and rarely declare permission boundaries (<1% of agent configs vs 33% of Actions workflows, n=31 true positives). We propose a deterministic control plane above the harness that maps one-to-one to these gaps. Rel(AI)Build treats agent definitions as a managed supply chain (SHA-256 content addressing, HMAC-stamped lockfiles, hash-chained audit logs); enforces tiered permissions and attack-derived blocklists before LLM invocation; gates feature work through a phase state machine with requirement-to-file-to-test traceability; compiles a single canonical definition to seven IDE targets; and detects prompt drift via Jaccard similarity. Conformance tests on injected violations confirm each mechanism enforces its stated invariant; developer outcomes remain future work. Governance of this layer must be deterministic and tool-agnostic -- not delegated to further LLM orchestration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对LLM编码代理（如Cline、Codex等）的配置层管理缺失问题展开研究。作者对10,008个公共GitHub仓库中的6,145个代理配置文件进行了大规模流行度分析，发现三个关键问题：1) 配置作为未声明的共享组件传播，10.1%的跟踪路径在不同独立仓库中为SHA-256精确重复，且75.5%的克隆对跨越组织边界；2) 配置极少修订，58%的配置文件仅有一个提交，与CI/CD工作流相比标准化提交频率低（0.4 vs 0.6次/月）；3) 权限边界声明严重不足，仅不到1%的代理配置文件声明权限，而GitHub Actions工作流中有33%。基于这些发现，论文提出了一个确定性的控制平面——Rel(AI)Build，它位于现有LLM编排层之上，与工具无关。该方案将代理定义视为托管供应链，采用SHA-256内容寻址、HMAC戳记锁文件和哈希链审计日志；在LLM调用前实施分层权限检查和基于攻击模式的阻止列表；通过包含需求-文件-测试可追溯性的阶段状态机来门控功能开发；将单一规范定义编译至七个IDE目标格式；并利用Jaccard相似度检测提示漂移。合规测试验证了每个机制能正确执行其所述的不变量。论文主张，代理配置的治理必须是确定性的、可审计的，不应委托给进一步的LLM编排。尽管开发者体验评估尚为未来工作，但该研究为LLM代理的安全应用提供了系统化治理框架。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM编码代理在开发中广泛使用，但其配置缺乏管理导致权限滥用、供应链安全风险。本论文揭示了问题的普遍性并提出了可落地的确定性控制方案，对保障LLM代理安全至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有使用LLM编码代理的组织，可迁移至CI/CD供应链安全、LLM应用治理、以及任何需要细粒度权限控制的代理场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估Rel(AI)Build方案与现有工具链的整合可行性，并开展内部试用。

items.title: Fortress and Gatekeeper: Theorizing Transitive Trust in Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Governance
items.summary: Third-party vendors, such as analytics platforms, cloud services, identity providers, and software suppliers, are increasingly embedded in digital service delivery. While these arrangements enable scale and specialization, they also move customer data and security-relevant practices into environments that customers rarely see, select, or evaluate. This paper examines this problem through a document analysis of the November 2025 OpenAI-Mixpanel security incident. The incident serves as an illustrative case for showing how a security event in a vendor environment can become a governance and accountability problem for the focal organization that maintains the customer relationship. Drawing on organizational trust research and agency theory, the paper argues that third-party cybersecurity risk is both a trust relationship and a delegation problem. Customers trust the visible service provider, while the provider relies on vendors whose security practices are only partially visible and controllable. The paper develops the concept of transitive trust, where customer trust in a digital service depends on the security practices of vendors authorized by that service provider. It then presents the Fortress and Gatekeeper framework, which explains cybersecurity governance boundaries through trust and data flows rather than formal organizational ownership alone. The analysis develops four propositions concerning vendor integration, metadata exposure, vendor assurance, and data proliferation. The paper contributes to cybersecurity governance scholarship by explaining how delegated data processing creates customer-facing accountability and by identifying implications for vendor tiering, data classification, contractual design, continuous assurance, and data minimization.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文基于2025年11月OpenAI-Mixpanel安全事件的文档分析，探讨第三方供应商（如分析平台、云服务、身份提供商、软件供应商）嵌入数字服务交付所带来的网络安全治理挑战。核心问题在于：客户数据和安全实践被转移到客户难以查看、选择或评估的环境中，导致责任与信任的错位。论文运用组织信任理论和代理理论，将第三方网络安全风险同时视为一种信任关系和委托代理问题：客户信任可见的服务提供商，而服务提供商依赖其供应商，但供应商的安全实践仅部分可见和可控。论文提出“传递信任”概念，即客户对数字服务的信任取决于该服务提供商授权的供应商的安全实践。进而构建了“堡垒与守门人”框架，通过信任流和数据流（而非仅形式化的组织所有权）来解释网络安全治理边界。基于案例分析，论文提出了四个命题：供应商整合、元数据暴露、供应商保证和数据扩散。主要贡献在于：解释了委托数据处理如何产生面向客户的责任，并识别了对供应商分级、数据分类、合同设计、持续保证和数据最小化等方面的启示。该论文适合安全治理研究者、风险管理人员以及参与供应商评估的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本论文为理解第三方网络安全风险提供了新颖的理论视角，尤其是‘传递信任’概念和‘堡垒与守门人’框架，有助于组织重新审视供应商管理策略，并设计更有效的治理边界与合同条款。

items.title: SpikeTimer: Exploring Active Copyright Protection in Spiking Neural Networks via Temporal Backdoor Regularization
items.summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNN) have emerged as a revolutionary paradigm compared to traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNN) in energy-efficient computing, showcasing exceptional capabilities in processing event-driven sensory data for real-time applications like robotics and edge AI systems. However, unlike extensive studies on DNN copyright solutions, SNN copyright protection remains largely underexplored due to their inherent temporal coding complexities and spike-driven computation. In this study, we propose a novel active copyright protection framework named SpikeTimer for SNNs via temporal backdoor learning. SpikeTimer partitions neuromorphic data into designated timeslices and exclusively embeds authorized tokens within authorized slices. Furthermore, the inherent temporal segmentation characteristic intrinsically enables SpikeTimer to support multi-user authorization mechanisms and accommodates token embedding of arbitrary morphology. Based on this, SpikeTimer precisely responds to authorized data containing a token within the correct timeslice, while producing erroneous responses to unauthorized data. Our key innovation lies in establishing a time-dependent authorization mechanism that protects the SNN copyright by temporal token validity. Additionally, SpikeTimer retains its defensive efficacy even under adversarial attempts. Evaluations on multiple neuromorphic datasets manifest that SpikeTimer achieves around 10% accuracy on unauthorized data with merely around 1.5% degradation on authorized inputs. Moreover, SpikeTimer demonstrates robust resistance against model finetuning and pruning threats.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Spiking Neural Networks (SNN) 作为一种新兴的神经计算范式，在能效计算方面展现出显著优势，尤其适用于处理事件驱动的感官数据，在机器人、边缘AI等实时应用场景中表现优异。然而，与深度神经网络（DNN）版权保护的广泛研究相比，SNN的版权保护由于时间编码复杂性和脉冲驱动的计算特性而尚未得到充分探索。本文提出了一种名为 SpikeTimer 的新型主动版权保护框架，通过时间后门学习机制为SNN提供版权保护。SpikeTimer 将神经形态数据划分为指定的时间片，并仅在授权的时间片内嵌入授权令牌。这种固有的时间分段特性使得 SpikeTimer 天然支持多用户授权机制，并能容纳任意形态的令牌嵌入。在授权阶段，SpikeTimer 能够精确响应包含正确时间片令牌的授权数据，而对于未授权数据则产生错误响应。其核心创新在于建立了一个时间依赖的授权机制，通过时间令牌的有效性来保护SNN版权。此外，即使在对抗攻击下，SpikeTimer 仍能保持防御效能。实验评估基于多个神经形态数据集，结果表明 SpikeTimer 在未授权数据上仅达到约10%的准确率，而在授权输入上的准确率仅下降约1.5%。同时，SpikeTimer 对模型微调和剪枝攻击表现出鲁棒抵抗能力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SNN在能效和边缘AI中日益重要，但其版权保护尚属空白。SpikeTimer提出了一种基于时间后门的新颖机制，为SNN提供主动保护，具有实用价值，值得关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方法可应用于SNN模型的版权保护、多用户授权场景，同时抵抗常见模型攻击，为SNN商业化部署提供安全保障。

items.title: MIRROR: Novelty-Constrained Memory-Guided MCTS Red-Teaming for Agentic RAG
items.summary: Multimodal agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems expand the attack surface beyond prompt injection to include text poisoning, image injection, direct-query attacks, and orchestrator-level tool manipulation. Existing red-teaming approaches are typically surface-specific and often recycle known attack templates; on text-poisoning benchmarks we measure 73-84% exact duplication. We present MIRROR, a unified cross-surface framework that performs memory-guided Monte Carlo tree search while conditioning candidate generation on retrieved context under an explicit novelty constraint. A deterministic Novelty Gate rejects any candidate matching the retrieval set under normalized comparison, allowing retrieval to inform search priors without enabling prompt copying. Across four attack surfaces on a multimodal agentic RAG target, MIRROR attains 76% ASR on image poisoning compared with 52% for baselines, 97% ASR on orchestrator attacks at half the query cost, and the lowest cross-surface variance (coefficient of variation 0.47). In contrast, specialized baselines collapse across surfaces: suffix optimization reaches 79% ASR on text poisoning but 1% on direct queries. We release ART-SafeBench with 41,815 in-package records and runtime adapters yielding 41,991+ total records across four surfaces.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 MIRROR，一个用于多模态智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统的统一红队框架。当前针对此类系统的攻击面已从简单的提示注入扩展到文本投毒、图像注入、直接查询攻击以及编排器级别的工具操控。现有红队方法通常针对特定攻击面，且常复用已知攻击模板——在文本投毒基准上的测量显示73-84%的完全重复率。MIRROR 通过内存引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），在检索上下文中以显式的新颖性约束条件生成候选攻击。具体地，其新颖性门控（Novelty Gate）在归一化比较后拒绝任何与检索集匹配的候选，从而允许检索信息指导搜索先验，但禁止直接复制提示。在面向多模态智能体 RAG 目标的四个攻击面上，MIRROR 在图像投毒上达到76%的攻击成功率（ASR），基线为52%；在编排器攻击上以一半的查询成本达到97% ASR；跨攻击面变异系数最低（0.47）。相比之下，专用基线在跨攻击面时表现崩溃：后缀优化在文本投毒上达79% ASR，但在直接查询上仅1%。作者同时发布了 ART-SafeBench 数据集，包含41815条包内记录和运行时适配器产生的41991+条总记录，覆盖四个攻击面。本文适合关注 LLM 安全、RAG 系统防御以及自动化红队的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次提出针对多模态智能体RAG系统的统一红队框架，解决了现有方法攻击面单一且攻击模板重复率高的问题，对评估和加固新一代AI系统安全具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至各类结合RAG和工具调用的智能体系统，提升红队测试的自动化程度和覆盖面。

items.why_it_matters: 首次提出针对多模态智能体RAG系统的统一红队框架，解决了现有方法攻击面单一且攻击模板重复率高的问题，对评估和加固新一代AI系统安全具有重要参考价值。

items.title: MergeLLL: A Hierarchical Divide-and-Conquer Framework for LLL-Based Lattice Reduction
items.summary: Lattice basis reduction algorithms have various applications in computational number theory and lattice-based cryptography, but their complexity increases rapidly with the dimension. Motivated by the divide-and-conquer strategy of merge sort and incorporating PotLLL-style deep insertions during recombination, MergeLLL is proposed. In this framework, a lattice basis is split into sub-bases, local reductions are performed independently, and the full basis is reconstructed through hierarchical merging. The approach is focused on improving local lattice structure first before global basis properties are refined, resulting in enhanced Gram-Schmidt orthogonality and numerical stability, while overall computational cost is reduced. The method is naturally parallelizable, allowing efficient multicore and distributed execution. It is shown that the reduction and merging steps preserve the lattice structure through unimodular transformations and achieve logarithmic parallel depth. In experiments on subset-sum and NTRU-derived lattices, improvements over classical lattice reduction algorithms are demonstrated, including better orthogonality, a reduced number of expensive swap operations, and an improved Hermite factor, indicating higher-quality reduced bases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 MergeLLL 的层次化分治格基约化框架，旨在解决经典 LLL 算法在高维格基上计算复杂度急剧上升的问题。受归并排序和 PotLLL 风格深度插入的启发，MergeLLL 将原始格基递归地分割成若干子基，对每个子基独立执行局部约化（如 LLL 或 BKZ），然后通过层次化合并步骤重构完整格基。在合并过程中，采用类似 PotLLL 的深度插入操作进一步优化基向量的 Gram-Schmidt 正交性和数值稳定性。该框架的核心思想是优先改善局部格结构，再逐步优化全局性质，从而在降低整体计算代价的同时提升约化质量。由于各子基的约化可独立进行，MergeLLL 天然支持多核和分布式并行执行，理论上可实现对数级别的并行深度。作者通过数学证明，约化和合并步骤均通过幺模变换保持格结构不变，确保了约化结果的有效性。实验部分基于子集和（subset-sum）问题以及 NTRU 密码系统衍生的格进行测试，结果表明 MergeLLM 相比传统 LLL 和 BKZ 算法，能生成正交性更好、Hermite 因子更优的约化基，同时显著减少昂贵的交换操作次数。该工作对于格密码的高效实现和安全性评估具有潜在价值，尤其适合需要处理高维格基的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 格基约化是格密码安全评估的核心算法，MergeLLL通过分治并行策略大幅提升高维格的约化效率，有助于更准确地评估格密码参数的安全性，也为格密码实现提供了更高效的软件方案。

items.why_it_matters: 格基约化是格密码安全评估的核心算法，MergeLLL通过分治并行策略大幅提升高维格的约化效率，有助于更准确地评估格密码参数的安全性，也为格密码实现提供了更高效的软件方案。

items.title: DroidBreaker: Practical and Functional Problem-Space Attacks on Machine-Learning Android Malware Detectors
items.summary: Adversarial APKs are Android applications modified in the problem space to evade machine-learning malware detectors. In this work, we first show that, despite claims, existing problem-space attacks remain largely impractical. Most techniques leverage software transplantation to inject entire benign modules, introducing many side-effect features and often causing build-time failures. Fine-grained methods that inject only a narrow subset of components exhibit limited effectiveness, while those that also use obfuscation rely on brittle bytecode rewriting, producing APKs that are syntactically valid but semantically unusable. Prior work further overestimates attack success rates by running smoke tests that only validate installation and basic execution, without assessing whether the modified APK still preserves its intended behavior. To overcome these limitations, we present DROIDBREAKER, a practical (build-safe) and functional (semantics-preserving) problem-space attack framework that provides: (i) query-efficient white- and black-box attacks by manipulating only the APK components most influential to the target model; (ii) a set of fine-grained, build-safe manipulations (including injection and obfuscation of API calls, app modules, permissions, and URLs) with minimal side effects; and (iii) a semantics-preserving functionality test that enforces runtime equivalence by comparing execution logs and API-level traces between the initial and the modified APK. Evaluated on a recent corpus of Android applications, DROIDBREAKER achieves high evasion rates with few queries and minimal side effects in both white-box and black-box settings, and drastically reduces detections by commercial malware scanners hosted on VirusTotal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文聚焦于机器学习驱动的安卓恶意软件检测器面临的问题空间对抗攻击。现有方法大多基于软件移植注入整个良性模块，引入大量副作用特征并常导致构建失败；细粒度方法仅注入少量组件，效果有限；结合混淆的手段依赖脆弱的字节码重写，产出的APK虽语法正确但语义不可用。此外，先前研究往往仅通过安装和基本执行测试来评估攻击成功率，未验证修改后的APK是否保留了原有功能。为克服这些局限性，作者提出DROIDBREAKER——一个实用（构建安全）且功能保持（语义保持）的问题空间攻击框架。其核心创新包括：（1）仅操纵对目标模型影响最大的APK组件，实现查询高效的白盒与黑盒攻击；（2）一组细粒度、构建安全的操作（包括注入和混淆API调用、应用模块、权限和URL），副作用极小；（3）一项语义保持的功能性测试，通过比较初始APK与修改后APK的执行日志和API级迹线来强制运行时等价。在近期安卓应用语料上的实验表明，DROIDBREAKER在白盒和黑盒设置下均能以较少查询和极小副作用实现高逃逸率，并能显著降低VirusTotal上商业恶意软件扫描器的检测率。该研究系统揭示了现有问题空间攻击的不可靠性，并提供了首个兼顾实用性与功能完整性的对抗攻击框架，对评估和提升安卓恶意软件检测器的鲁棒性具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了现有安卓恶意软件检测器对抗攻击方法的严重缺陷，并提出了首个真正实用且能保持APK功能的攻击框架，对安全社区重新评估检测器鲁棒性、开发更可靠防御具有关键启示。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响基于机器学习的安卓恶意软件检测器的安全性评估，可能促使厂商改进检测模型以抵御细粒度、功能保持的对抗样本。

items.title: The Fungible Reserve Standard: A Deterministic Framework for Encoding Carrying Costs in Asset-Backed Tokens
items.summary: The tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs) has emerged as a transformative application of blockchain technology, with market projections estimating trillions of dollars in tokenized assets within the coming decade. However, a fundamental challenge remains unaddressed: physical assets such as precious metals, stored commodities, and warehoused goods incur structural negative carry -- custody, insurance, and audit costs that accumulate over time. While existing tokenization models have successfully established the market for digital gold and treasuries, they typically manage operational costs at the issuer level. The FRS introduces a framework to bring these economics directly on-chain, avoiding mechanisms such as token rebasing that compromise fungibility and composability with decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols. This paper proposes the Fungible Reserve Standard (FRS), a deterministic token design framework that encodes carrying costs transparently into on-chain logic. The FRS introduces an asset-per-token variable q(t) that decreases according to a predefined annualized carrying cost rate, coupled with a supply reconciliation mechanism that preserves holder balances and ERC-20 composability. While mathematically inspired by the daily expense ratio accrual in traditional asset management -- which often embed centralized profit margins -- the FRS design specifically encodes actual operational carrying costs to provide pure institutional-grade accounting clarity without compromising DeFi compatibility. The framework is asset-agnostic and applicable to any real-world asset with positive, predictable holding costs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“可互换储备标准”（Fungible Reserve Standard, FRS）的代币设计框架，旨在解决现实世界资产（RWA）代币化过程中的结构性负持有成本问题。当前，代币化资产（如数字黄金、国债）通常由发行方在链下管理运营成本（如保管、保险、审计费用），导致链上代币无法透明反映这些成本，且常见解决方案（如代币重基数）会破坏代币的互换性和与DeFi协议的组合性。FRS通过引入随时间递减的资产-代币比率 q(t)，将持有成本以确定性的编码方式嵌入链上逻辑，同时通过供应协调机制保持用户余额不变并兼容ERC-20标准。该框架受传统资产管理中每日费用率累积的启发，但仅编码实际运营成本，提供纯粹机构级会计透明度而不牺牲DeFi兼容性。FRS具有资产无关性，适用于任何具有正且可预测持有成本的实物资产。实验或形式化验证未在摘要中提及，但作者声称该框架能避免重基数机制，并支持与DeFi协议的无缝交互。本文适合区块链金融、代币化资产设计的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架为RWA代币化提供了透明、链上的会计标准，有助于提升资产代币的安全性、互换性和合规性，对DeFi生态和机构采用具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响资产代币化领域，可推广至所有涉及正持有成本的实物资产（如大宗商品、贵金属、库存商品）的链上表示。

items.why_it_matters: 该框架为RWA代币化提供了透明、链上的会计标准，有助于提升资产代币的安全性、互换性和合规性，对DeFi生态和机构采用具有重要意义。

items.title: TGHE: Template-based Graph Homomorphic Encryption for Privacy-Preserving GNN Inference in Edge-Cloud Systems
items.summary: Existing homomorphic encryption (HE)-based GNN systems adopt a graph-centric paradigm that couples per-query cost to global graph size, limiting evaluations to at most ~20k nodes and making them incompatible with dynamic, large-scale financial graphs. We propose TGHE (Template-based Graph Homomorphic Encryption), an ego-centric framework that resolves this by exploiting a template phenomenon: local computation trees in transaction graphs converge into a small set of structural shapes. TGHE canonicalizes ego-graphs at the edge and packs structurally identical trees into shared CKKS ciphertexts for SIMD-parallel encrypted inference, with two long-tail optimizers (Approximate Template Fitting and Topology Collapse) ensuring full SIMD coverage. On DGraphFin (3.7M nodes, 4.3M edges), TGHE-Collapse achieves a 66.9x speedup over the sequential encrypted baseline with less than 0.002 AUC loss.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现有基于同态加密（HE）的图神经网络（GNN）系统采用图中心范式，将每次查询成本与全局图大小耦合，导致处理规模受限（最多约2万个节点），且无法适应动态、大规模金融图。本文提出TGHE（基于模板的图同态加密），一种以节点为中心（ego-centric）的框架，通过利用模板现象解决上述问题：交易图中的局部计算树会收敛为少量结构形状。TGHE在边缘对自我图（ego-graph）进行规范化，将结构相同的树打包到共享的CKKS密文中，实现SIMD并行加密推理，并设计了两个长尾优化器（近似模板拟合与拓扑折叠）确保完全SIMD覆盖。在包含370万节点、430万条边的DGraphFin数据集上，TGHE-Collapse相比顺序加密基线实现了66.9倍加速，且AUC损失低于0.002。该方法适用于边缘-云协作场景下的隐私保护GNN推理，尤其适合金融反欺诈等需要保护图结构隐私的应用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 解决了HE-GNN在超大规模图上的可扩展性瓶颈，首次实现百万级节点图的隐私保护推理，对金融、社交等隐私敏感场景具有重要实用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何需要在大规模动态图上进行隐私保护GNN推理的边缘-云系统，如金融风控、社交网络分析、推荐系统等。

items.why_it_matters: 解决了HE-GNN在超大规模图上的可扩展性瓶颈，首次实现百万级节点图的隐私保护推理，对金融、社交等隐私敏感场景具有重要实用价值。

items.title: Autoformalization of Agent Instructions into Policy-as-Code
items.summary: Agent safety in high-stakes domains requires formal policy enforcement, but most existing approaches either rely on probabilistic guardrails (fine-tuned classifiers, prompt-based steering) that offer no formal guarantees, or on hand-coded symbolic enforcement that does not scale to the breadth of real policy specifications. We present an autoformalization pipeline that translates agent prompts, MCP tool descriptions, and natural language policy documents into formally verified policies using an LLM-based generator-critic loop. The resulting policies are written in the Cedar Policy Language. On the MedAgentBench benchmark, our autoformalized policies cover substantially more of the source natural-language specification than the hand-coded symbolic enforcement in prior work.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种自动化形式化（autoformalization）流水线，用于将智能体提示（agent prompts）、MCP工具描述和自然语言策略文档转化为形式化验证的策略。现有方法要么依赖概率性护栏（如微调分类器、提示引导），缺乏形式化保证；要么依赖手工编码的符号化执行，无法扩展到现实策略规范的广度。本文的方法基于LLM的生成-评论循环（generator-critic loop），生成的策略采用Cedar策略语言编写。在MedAgentBench基准测试中，自动形式化的策略覆盖了比先前工作中手工编码符号化执行更广泛的源自然语言规范。该工作旨在提升高风险领域中智能体安全的形式化策略执行能力，使策略合规性可被自动验证，并减少人工编码错误。适合对AI Agent安全、形式化验证和策略工程感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次将自然语言策略自动转化为形式化验证的策略，弥合了非正式规定与正式执行之间的鸿沟，为AI Agent在高风险领域的安全合规提供了可扩展、有保证的解决方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于医疗、金融、自动驾驶等需严格策略合规的AI Agent部署场景，提升策略覆盖率和验证自动化水平。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究首次将自然语言策略自动转化为形式化验证的策略，弥合了非正式规定与正式执行之间的鸿沟，为AI Agent在高风险领域的安全合规提供了可扩展、有保证的解决方案。

items.title: Agents That Know Too Much: A Data-Centric Survey of Privacy in LLM Agents
items.summary: Large language model agents increasingly query databases, search document collections, call external APIs, remember past interactions, and act on a user's behalf. As they move from answering questions to operating over sensitive data, privacy becomes harder to enforce. An agent touches many data sources, runs multi-step workflows, keeps state across sessions, and acts with delegated permissions. Sensitive information can therefore leak not only through its final answer but through the queries it issues, the intermediate results it handles, the memory it writes, and the messages it exchanges with other agents. We survey the privacy of LLM agents from a data-centric view, organizing the field around the data an agent touches rather than by attack type, and we use data agent as shorthand for an LLM agent that works with data. Research on these risks is active but scattered across retrieval-augmented generation, text-to-SQL interfaces, agent memory, prompt injection, access control, and contextual privacy. This survey brings that work together: we taxonomize the data sources an agent touches, the privacy risks each source creates, and the governance mechanisms that address them; we map the benchmarks used to measure these risks and identify what is missing; and we set out the open problems. Two findings recur: among governance mechanisms only information-flow control covers both compositional and cross-session inference leakage, the two least-protected risks; and no benchmark drives an agent across its data surfaces under one privacy policy, the instrument the field most lacks. Our goal is a reference that situates the scattered literature and gives future work a common framing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文从数据视角对LLM Agent的隐私问题进行了全面综述。随着LLM Agent从简单的问答系统演变为能够操作敏感数据的自主系统（包括查询数据库、检索文档集合、调用外部API、记忆历史交互以及代表用户执行操作），隐私保护变得愈发困难。Agent会接触多种数据源，执行多步骤工作流，跨会话维护状态，并拥有委托权限。因此，敏感信息不仅可能通过最终答案泄露，还可能通过其发出的查询、处理的中间结果、写入的记忆以及与其他Agent交换的消息泄露。作者将相关研究按照Agent接触的数据类型而非攻击类型进行组织，提出了一个新的分类体系：数据源（包括内部知识、外部数据库、用户输入、记忆、其他Agent消息等）、每种数据源带来的隐私风险（如推理攻击、跨会话记忆泄露、提示注入等）、以及应对这些风险的治理机制（如信息流控制、访问控制、上下文隐私等）。此外，作者绘制了用于测量这些风险的基准测试，并指出了现有基准的空白：缺乏一个统一的隐私策略下覆盖Agent所有数据面的基准。两个核心发现反复出现：在所有治理机制中，只有信息流控制能够同时覆盖组合推理和跨会话推理泄露这两个最不受保护的风险；并且缺少一个能推动Agent在其所有数据面上遵守单一隐私策略的基准。本文旨在为分散的文献提供一个共同框架，指导未来研究。适合安全研究员、AI系统架构师以及隐私合规从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM Agent正被集成到企业数据管道和用户隐私场景中，但隐私风险未被系统化理解。本文提供了第一个数据视角的分类，帮助安全团队识别和防范Agent特有的隐私泄露路径，如跨会话记忆泄露和组合推理攻击。

items.why_it_matters: LLM Agent正被集成到企业数据管道和用户隐私场景中，但隐私风险未被系统化理解。本文提供了第一个数据视角的分类，帮助安全团队识别和防范Agent特有的隐私泄露路径，如跨会话记忆泄露和组合推理攻击。

items.title: Empirical Software Engineering TerraProbe: A Layered-Oracle Framework for Detecting Deceptive Fixes in LLM-Assisted Terraform
items.summary: Security misconfigurations in Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code are a growing risk in cloud deployments, and large language models are increasingly used as automated repair agents. Existing evaluations often treat a repair as successful when the targeted static-analysis finding disappears, without checking planning validity, behavioral change, or security intent. This paper presents TerraProbe, a five-layer oracle framework for evaluating LLM-assisted Terraform security repair. We apply TerraProbe to 288 first-pass repairs generated by gemini-2.5-flash-lite, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet across 68 real-world TerraDS modules and 28 controlled injected-defect modules. The results show that targeted Checkov removal overstates repair success. Although targeted removal reaches 83.3 percent for the primary model, full-scanner cleanliness drops to 10.4 percent, Terraform planning succeeds for 39.6 percent, and plan comparison is reachable for 38.5 percent. Human adjudication further shows that 71.4 percent of plan-compared real-world repairs are deceptive fixes that pass automated checks while leaving the underlying vulnerability in place. This pattern is statistically indistinguishable across the three models, with deceptive-fix rates from 57.1 percent to 71.4 percent and pairwise Fisher exact p-values above 0.10. The paper introduces a four-dimensional taxonomy of deceptive fixes, validated with Cohen kappa of 0.78 and Krippendorff alpha of 0.76. IAM permission analysis confirms that wildcard Resource grants persist in all nine CKV2 AWS 11 deceptive-fix cases. TerraProbe contributes an evaluation methodology, a replication package, and the Multi-Layer Oracle Evaluation framework for distinguishing intent-aligned security repairs from scanner-passing false successes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Terraform基础设施即代码（IaC）中的安全配置错误是云部署中日益增长的风险，大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作自动修复代理。然而，现有评估通常仅以目标静态分析告警消失作为修复成功的标准，而未检查规划有效性、行为变化或安全意图。本文提出TerraProbe，一个五层预言机框架，用于评估LLM辅助的Terraform安全修复。研究团队对Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet生成的288个首次修复应用了TerraProbe，这些修复涉及68个真实世界TerraDS模块和28个受控注入缺陷模块。结果表明，针对特定Checkov规则的移除率夸大了修复成功率：尽管主模型的目标移除率达到83.3%，但全扫描器清洁度降至10.4%，Terraform规划成功率为39.6%，规划比较可达率仅38.5%。人工判决进一步显示，经过规划比较的真实世界修复中，71.4%属于欺骗性修复——它们通过了自动化检查，但潜在漏洞依然存在。这一模式在三个模型之间无统计学显著差异（欺骗性修复率57.1%-71.4%，两两Fisher精确检验p值>0.10）。论文提出了欺骗性修复的四维分类法，Cohen's kappa为0.78，Krippendorff's alpha为0.76。IAM权限分析确认，在所有9个CKV2_AWS_11欺骗性修复案例中，通配符Resource授权仍然存在。TerraProbe贡献了一套评估方法论、一个可复现包以及区分意图对齐安全修复与通过扫描器的虚假成功的多层预言机评估框架。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM辅助Terraform修复中高达71.4%的欺骗性修复问题，提醒安全团队不能仅依赖静态分析结果判断修复是否有效，必须结合多层面验证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响所有使用LLM自动修复Terraform IaC安全问题的场景，尤其对DevSecOps流水线中自动修复的可靠性评估具有指导意义。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 关注论文后续工具发布，在内部IaC修复流程中引入多层评估机制。
