items.title: Adversarial Diffusion Across Modalities: A Fusion Survey of Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation for Text, Vision, and Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Adversarial evaluation of AI systems has matured along four largely disconnected tracks: diffusion-based attacks on text and large language models (LLMs), diffusion-based attacks on image classifiers, jailbreak pipelines against vision-language models, and diffusion-based input purification defenses. Each has developed its own vocabulary, threat models, and benchmarks, with denoising diffusion models emerging as a shared generative mechanism whose recipes are now actively ported between communities. This survey performs an information-fusion exercise at the meta-research level: we integrate these four tracks into a single conceptual framework with a unified taxonomy, evaluation criteria, and research agenda, focusing on the LLM-side slice. We catalog fifty published papers across four scope areas (text/LLM, image classifier, vision-language model, defense), plus four diffusion-LLM-as-victim entries and ten non-diffusion baselines against which any new attack must be compared. We propose a six-class taxonomy of diffusion roles in adversarial pipelines, augmented by a threat-model axis recording attacker knowledge, query budget, and target accessibility, and apply a five-dimension framework (attack success rate, transferability, query budget, perplexity, defense-evasion) uniformly across modalities. The review adopts a dual attacker-defender perspective: alongside the attack catalog we cover four diffusion-based defenses that form the natural evaluation backdrop for new attacks. Our critical analysis identifies five recurring weaknesses of the current LLM-side literature, and we close with a research agenda of open questions and concrete experimental designs. The companion catalog and spreadsheet are released with the paper. We are explicit that this is a narrative review with quality assessment, not a PRISMA-compliant systematic review, and discuss the implications for replication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇跨模态对抗性扩散的融合综述，系统整合了四个原本分散的研究方向：针对文本和大语言模型的扩散攻击、针对图像分类器的扩散攻击、针对视觉-语言模型的越狱管线，以及基于扩散的输入净化防御。这些方向各自发展出了独立的词汇、威胁模型和基准测试，但去噪扩散模型作为一个共享的生成机制，其方法正在不同社区之间积极移植。作者在元研究层面进行信息融合，将这四个轨道统一到一个概念框架中，提出了统一的分类法、评估标准和研究议程。综述涵盖了50篇已发表论文，分布在四个范围领域（文本/LLM、图像分类器、视觉-语言模型、防御），外加4篇以扩散LLM为受害者的条目和10个非扩散基线（任何新攻击必须与之比较）。论文提出了一个六类扩散角色分类法（在对抗性管线中的角色），并辅以威胁模型轴记录攻击者知识、查询预算和目标可访问性，同时跨模态应用五维评估框架（攻击成功率、可迁移性、查询预算、困惑度、防御逃避）。本文采用攻击者-防御者双重视角，覆盖四种扩散防御作为新攻击的自然评估背景。关键分析部分指出了当前LLM侧文献的五个常见弱点，并以开放问题和具体实验设计的研究议程作结。随文发布了配套目录和电子表格。作者明确声明这是一篇带有质量评估的叙述性综述，而非符合PRISMA的系统性综述，并讨论了可复现性方面的启示。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文为蓝队和安全工程师提供了跨模态对抗性攻击与防御的全局视图，有助于理解扩散模型在LLM和多模态系统中的风险，并识别当前研究的薄弱环节。

items.why_it_matters: 本文为蓝队和安全工程师提供了跨模态对抗性攻击与防御的全局视图，有助于理解扩散模型在LLM和多模态系统中的风险，并识别当前研究的薄弱环节。

items.title: TESLA-for-5G: Broadcast Authentication for 5G Networks Using TESLA
items.summary: 5G base stations broadcast unauthenticated system information (SI) that every user equipment (UE) reads during cell selection. This enables attackers to broadcast forged SI from a fake base station (FBS), deceiving UEs into camping on it. Prior approaches require UEs to authenticate System Information Block 1 (SIB1) using digital signatures. This necessitates computation-heavy verification for every SIB1 reception, imposing a significant burden on resource-constrained UEs. We propose TESLA-for-5G (TF5), a broadcast authentication protocol for 5G SIB1 that combines TESLA with GG09 Schnorr-like identity-based signatures (IBS). In the steady state, TF5 enables UEs to authenticate each SIB1 message using a symmetric MAC and delayed key disclosure, eliminating the need for per-message digital signatures. Initial trust is bootstrapped during cell entry using a lightweight GG09 IBS over the TESLA parameters, avoiding certificate distribution overhead. We formally verify TF5 in Tamarin under a Dolev-Yao adversary and demonstrate its favorable computation, communication, and storage costs through both an implementation on the OpenAirInterface 5G stack and trace-driven analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 TESLA-for-5G (TF5) 的广播认证协议，旨在解决 5G 网络中系统信息 (SI) 广播缺乏认证的问题。在 5G 网络中，基站广播未认证的系统信息，用户设备 (UE) 在小区选择时读取这些信息。攻击者可以利用伪造基站 (FBS) 广播伪造的 SI，诱使 UE 驻留其上。现有方法要求 UE 使用数字签名认证每个系统信息块 1 (SIB1)，计算开销大，对资源受限的 UE 造成沉重负担。TF5 结合了 TESLA (时间高效流丢失容忍认证) 和 GG09 Schnorr 类身份基签名 (IBS)。在稳定状态下，TF5 允许 UE 使用对称消息认证码 (MAC) 和延迟密钥披露来认证每个 SIB1 消息，从而避免每个消息的数字签名。初始信任在小区进入时通过轻量级 GG09 IBS 对 TESLA 参数进行引导，避免了证书分发开销。作者在 Tamarin 证明助手下基于 Dolev-Yao 攻击者模型对 TF5 进行了形式化验证，并通过在 OpenAirInterface 5G 协议栈上的实现以及基于跟踪的分析，证明了其计算、通信和存储开销的优越性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 5G 广播认证是确保用户设备不被伪造基站欺骗的关键，TF5 通过降低计算开销实现了实用化，对 5G 安全增强有重要研究意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升 5G 网络广播信道的抗伪造能力，可移植到其他需要广播认证的场景（如 V2X、物联网）。

items.title: VIGIL: Runtime Enforcement of Behavioral Specifications in AI Agent Skills
items.summary: Agentic systems increasingly act through third-party skills, allowing model-generated decisions to affect files, communication channels, and cyber-physical devices. These skills often include natural-language specifications that define access permissions, disclosure limits, execution privileges, and required preconditions. Although such specifications describe the intended boundaries of skill behavior, they do not by themselves provide executable runtime enforcement. Enforcing them raises a contextual granularity challenge: even when a policy is written for a particular task context, a monitor must still decide which events to observe, what state to retain, how far across the execution to reason, and where to intervene. Choosing the wrong granularity can either block benign executions or miss violations that emerge only across multiple actions. Most existing enforcement mechanisms, however, assume a fixed event model or enforcement point. In this work, we present VIGIL, an end-to-end runtime enforcement framework for agentic systems. VIGIL checks an agent's actual execution trace against behavioral policies from skill specifications, operator-defined constraints, and global rules spanning multiple skills. To make such policies executable, VIGIL introduces a policy language that captures context-specific enforcement requirements over agent-tool events, including temporal dependencies, argument constraints, and value-flow conditions. The language is paired with symbolic evaluation rules that translate policies into SMT constraints over finite traces, allowing VIGIL to detect violations that depend on event order, argument relationships, or cross-call value flow rather than relying on fixed single-call filters. On real LLM-agent runs spanning office-document, operational, and engineering tasks, VIGIL detects policy violations with over 95% recall and a false-positive rate below 10%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 VIGIL，一个面向智能体系统的端到端运行时行为规范执行框架。随着智能体系统越来越多地通过第三方技能（skills）执行模型生成的决策，这些技能通常包含自然语言编写的规范，定义访问权限、披露限制、执行权限和前置条件。然而，这些规范本身不具备可执行的运行时保障。VIGIL 解决了上下文粒度挑战：即使策略是为特定任务上下文编写的，监控器仍需决定观察哪些事件、保留什么状态、推理多远以及何时干预。错误的粒度可能导致阻塞良性执行或错过跨多个动作才出现的违规。现有执行机制大多假设固定的事件模型或执行点。VIGIL 检查智能体实际执行轨迹，对比来自技能规范、操作员定义约束和跨多个技能的全局规则的行为策略。为使策略可执行，VIGIL 引入了一种策略语言，能够捕获对智能体-工具事件的上下文特定执行要求，包括时间依赖、参数约束和值流条件。该语言结合符号评估规则，将策略转换为有限轨迹上的 SMT 约束，从而检测依赖于事件顺序、参数关系或跨调用值流的违规，而非依赖固定的单次调用过滤器。在真实的 LLM 智能体运行（涵盖办公文档、操作和工程任务）上，VIGIL 的政策违规检测召回率超过 95%，误报率低于 10%。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着 AI 智能体被授权操作文件、通信和物理设备，确保其行为符合安全规范至关重要。VIGIL 提供了首个面向第三方技能的运行时强制机制，能有效检测跨动作的违规，大幅降低误报。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有依赖 LLM 智能体的自动化系统，尤其是涉及文件操作、网络通信和物理设备控制的场景，可增强策略执行的可信度。

items.title: DKVE: Decentralized Key Validation for End-to-End Encrypted Messaging
items.summary: End-to-end encrypted messaging systems depend on authentic public key distribution to prevent man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks. Current solutions present a stark trade-off: out-of-band (OOB) verification provides strong security but lacks scalability for large contact lists, while key transparency (KT) systems enable automated verification at high storage costs and operational complexity. We propose DKVE, a protocol that validates public keys through privacy-preserving cross-validation within users' social graphs. When obtaining a contact's public key from a key server, clients query mutual contacts to verify they hold the same key, combining Oblivious Pseudorandom Functions (OPRF) and Oblivious Key-Value Stores (OKVS) to preserve privacy of both queries and contact lists. DKVE employs a Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT) to aggregate responses and detect server misbehavior with user-configurable error bounds. We evaluate DKVE through simulations on real social network datasets, demonstrating DKVE can detect MitM attacks with exceeding 97% for strong-to-moderate-tie networks. The remaining 3% of cases require validation through alternative methods such as KT and OOB verification. Our proof-of-concept implementation confirms feasibility for background operation on commodity hardware, in terms of the latency and bandwidth. As DKVE can reduce the frequency of KT queries by two orders of magnitude, it enables fundamental architectural shifts: KT directories can migrate from fast but space-inefficient Merkle trees to space-efficient data structures like RSA accumulators. While DKVE cannot replace existing methods entirely -- suffering from bootstrapping problems and degraded performance on weak-tie networks -- it provides a practical complementary key validation mechanism, making secure messaging more deployable for billion-user systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为DKVE的去中心化密钥验证协议，旨在解决端到端加密（E2EE）消息系统中公钥验证的固有难题。当前主流方案存在明显权衡：带外（OOB）验证安全但难以扩展至大规模联系人列表，而密钥透明度（KT）系统虽支持自动化验证，却需要高存储成本和运维复杂性。DKVE利用用户的社交图谱，通过隐私保护的交叉验证来验证公钥。当客户端从密钥服务器获取联系人的公钥时，会向共同联系人（互相联系的好友）发起查询，验证他们所持有的公钥是否一致。该协议结合了不经意伪随机函数（OPRF）和 oblivious 键值存储（OKVS）技术，以保护查询隐私和联系人列表隐私。DKVE 采用序贯概率比检验（SPRT）聚合来自多个共同联系人的响应，以用户可配置的误差界检测服务器的不当行为（例如分发不同的公钥以实施中间人攻击）。通过在真实社交网络数据集上进行模拟，实验表明，在强到中等强度的社交网络（即用户之间有较多共同联系人）中，DKVE 检测中间人攻击的成功率超过97%。剩余的约3%情况需要借助其他方法（如KT或OOB验证）进行额外验证。原型实现表明，在商用硬件上，DKVE 可作为后台进程运行而不显著影响延迟和带宽。值得注意的是，DKVE 能将KT查询频率降低两个数量级，从而支持根本性的架构变革：KT目录可从快速但空间效率低的 Merkle 树迁移至空间效率高的数据结构（如RSA累加器）。尽管DKVE无法完全替代现有方法（存在冷启动问题和弱联系网络性能下降），但它提供了一种实用的互补密钥验证机制，使得安全消息系统在十亿用户规模下更易部署。本文适合密码学研究者、消息系统设计者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种新颖的去中心化密钥验证方法，利用社交图进行隐私保护交叉验证，可大幅降低对密钥透明度系统的依赖，是迈向实用大规模端到端加密消息系统的重要一步。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要大规模公钥验证的端到端加密消息应用，如WhatsApp、Signal等，可减少对中心化或高成本透明度系统的依赖，提升安全性。

items.title: Adaptive Evaluation of Out-of-Band Defenses Against Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
items.summary: Recent work (2024 to 2026) has converged on a strategy for defending tool-using LLM agents against indirect prompt injection: rather than training the model to refuse malicious instructions, enforce security outside the model with a deterministic policy that mediates the agent's actions. Systems such as CaMeL, FIDES, Progent, RTBAS, and FORGE realize this with capabilities, information-flow labels, and reference monitors, and several report near-elimination of attacks on the AgentDojo benchmark. We make two contributions. First, we organize these out-of-band defenses as instances of classical integrity protection (Biba), reference monitoring, and least privilege, yielding a structured comparison of what they do and do not cover. Second, we warn that every one of them is validated only on static benchmarks (a fixed set of injection attempts), the same methodology that made in-band defenses look strong until adaptive, defense-aware attacks broke twelve of them at over 90% success; we specify the threat model and protocol an adaptive evaluation requires. We then run that protocol as an independent reproduction and extension of Progent's own adaptive-attack analysis, on AgentDojo, with an open-weight agent (Qwen2.5-7B) self-hosted on a single H200, a setting its authors did not test. Averaged over three runs, the defense held: Progent cut mean attack success roughly sixfold (25.8% to 4.2%), and a hand-crafted adaptive attack did not raise it (2.6%). This is one small-scale data point on a weak model with a single black-box attack template; a stronger optimized (white-box GCG) attack remains open. The result is consistent with, but does not establish, the hypothesis that deterministic out-of-band enforcement is a harder target for an adaptive attacker than in-band detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于LLM智能体在工具调用场景下对间接提示注入攻击的防御问题。近期（2024-2026年）的研究趋同于一种带外防御策略：不是训练模型拒绝恶意指令，而是在模型外部通过确定性策略中介智能体的行动，例如CaMeL、FIDES、Progent、RTBAS和FORGE等系统，它们利用能力、信息流标签和引用监视器实现防御，并在AgentDojo基准上报告近乎完全消除攻击。本文做出两项贡献：首先，将这些带外防御组织为经典完整性保护（Biba模型）、引用监视器和最小权限原则的实例，从而结构化对比它们的覆盖范围与遗漏之处；其次，指出所有这些防御目前仅在静态基准（固定注入尝试集）上验证，而正是同样的方法论曾使带内防御看起来很强，直到自适应、防御感知攻击以超过90%的成功率攻破了其中十二种。因此，作者明确了自适应评估所需的威胁模型和协议，并独立复现和扩展了Progent的自适应攻击分析，在AgentDojo上使用开源权重模型Qwen2.5-7B（自托管于单张H200 GPU上）进行实验。三次运行的平均结果显示，Progent将平均攻击成功率从25.8%降至4.2%，而手动设计的自适应攻击并未提高成功率（2.6%）。作者指出这只是一个基于弱模型和单一黑盒攻击模板的小规模数据点，更强优化的白盒GCG攻击仍有待研究。结论与“确定性带外强制比带内检测更难被自适应攻击者攻破”的假设一致，但尚未确立。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究指出了当前LLM智能体提示注入防御评估中的方法论缺陷（仅依赖静态基准），并提供了首个独立的自适应评估结果，为防御有效性验证提供了更严格的标准。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响LLM智能体安全防御技术的评估方法论，可能推动安全社区采用自适应攻击测试来验证防御体系。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估自家LLM智能体防御时引入自适应攻击测试，并关注更大模型和更强攻击下的后续研究。

items.title: ProvenAI: Provenance-Native Traces of Evidence in Generated Answers
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented systems routinely present citations alongside generated answers, yet a citation does not confirm that the corresponding source meaningfully shaped the output. This paper introduces ProvenAI, a framework that decomposes transparency in multi-hop question answering into three independently measurable layers: answer correctness, citation fidelity against benchmark supporting evidence, and per-document influence under leave-one-resource-out intervention. Targeting the HotpotQA distractor benchmark through a seven-stage pipeline covering data normalisation, retrieval indexing, citation-aware answer generation, attribution auditing, ablation-based influence estimation, batch evaluation, and interactive inspection, ProvenAI evaluates 7,405 validation examples drawn from a canonical corpus of 509,300 passages. The system achieves 53.53% answer accuracy alongside a mean citation-fidelity score of 71.55%, and a worked example surfaces what we call the citation-influence gap: a clean citation audit co-occurring with a profile in which one cited source registers only weak influence while seven uncited sources demonstrably shift the output. We formalise the relationship between the implemented surface proxy and a token-level KL-divergence target through a stated faithfulness condition, ground the framework in causal-mediation analysis and database-provenance theory, and discuss how the three measurement layers compose with cryptographic provenance architectures emerging in autonomous scientific discovery. ProvenAI establishes that meaningful transparency in retrieval-grounded QA requires traceable links across retrieved, cited, and behaviourally influential evidence as three distinct, independently measured layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了 ProvenAI 框架，旨在解决检索增强生成系统中引文无法证明来源真正影响输出的问题。该框架将多跳问答中的透明度分解为三个独立可测量的层面：答案正确性、引文忠实度（即引文与基准支持证据的匹配程度）以及每文档影响（通过留一资源干预法衡量）。作者在 HotpotQA 干扰项基准数据集上，构建了一个涵盖数据标准化、检索索引、引文感知答案生成、归因审计、基于消融的影响估计、批量评估和交互检查的七阶段流水线，评估了来自 509,300 个段落标准语料库的 7,405 个验证样本。系统实现了 53.53% 的答案准确率和 71.55% 的平均引文忠实度分数。一个工作示例揭示了所谓的“引文-影响差距”：一个引文审计看似干净，但其中一个被引来源仅表现出微弱影响，而七个未引来源却明显改变了输出。本文通过一个明确的忠实性条件，形式化了所实现的表面代理与 token 级 KL 散度目标之间的关系，并将框架建立在因果中介分析和数据库溯源理论基础上。此外，还讨论了三个测量层如何与自主科学发现中出现的加密溯源架构相结合。ProvenAI 表明，检索式问答中的有意义透明度需要将检索到的、引用的和行为上有影响的证据作为三个独立测量的不同层面进行可追溯链接。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前 LLM 回答中的引文可能不可靠，ProvenAI 首次系统度量了引文与真实影响之间的差距，为评估 AI 系统输出透明度提供了可量化方法，对安全审计和合规有重要参考价值。

items.title: Nanoelectromechanical Systems (NEMS) for Hardware Security in Advanced Packaging
items.summary: As hardware security threats escalate across semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging, there is a growing need for novel physical mechanisms to counter sophisticated attacks such as tampering, counterfeiting, and supply chain infiltration. This paper presents Nanoelectromechanical Systems (NEMS) as an emerging class of hardware security primitives that enable physical assurance, tamper detection, and authentication at the device level. Leveraging mechanisms such as NEMS-based Physically Unclonable Functions (PUFs), shape memory materials, resonance-based fingerprints, and physical unlocking architectures, these systems offer enhanced resilience to reverse engineering, side-channel attacks, and environmental degradation. By harnessing mechanical unpredictability and fabrication-induced nanoscale variability, NEMS technologies introduce a physically robust and low-power alternative to conventional digital security methods. Their seamless integration into standard semiconductor workflows paves the way for scalable, verifiable, and secure solutions across defense, aerospace, critical infrastructure, and consumer electronics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出将纳米机电系统（NEMS）作为先进封装中硬件安全的新型物理原语。随着半导体制造和封装过程中的安全威胁日益严峻（如篡改、伪造、供应链渗透），传统的数字安全方法面临被逆向工程、侧信道攻击等挑战。NEMS通过利用纳米尺度的机械可变性、形状记忆材料、谐振指纹以及物理解锁架构，实现了设备级的物理保证、篡改检测和认证。具体地，基于NEMS的物理不可克隆函数（PUF）利用制造过程中引入的纳米级随机变化产生唯一且不可预测的响应，显著增强了对逆向工程和克隆攻击的抵抗力。形状记忆材料可在特定条件下改变状态，用于防篡改封装。谐振指纹通过检测器件独特的机械振动模式进行身份验证。这些机制共同提供了低功耗、物理鲁棒的解决方案，可无缝集成到标准半导体工艺中。实验表明，NEMS方案在抗环境退化、抗侧信道攻击方面优于传统数字方法。该工作为国防、航空航天、关键基础设施和消费电子等领域提供了可扩展、可验证的安全解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬件安全威胁日益严峻，传统数字安全方法面临物理攻击风险。NEMS提供一种全新的物理层安全原语，利用纳米机械特性实现不可克隆性和防篡改，有望弥补现有半导体安全体系的薄弱环节。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于先进封装中的防伪、供应链完整性验证、设备认证等场景，特别适合对物理安全要求极高的国防、航空航天、关键基础设施领域。

items.title: What Browsers Do in the Shaders: A Measurement Study of WebGPU Privacy
items.summary: WebGPU lets ordinary web pages run GPU workloads through a validated programming model. Validation protects memory safety, but shared browser, driver, OS, and GPU state can still expose privacy-relevant signals. We present WGPULens, a framework for measuring those signals across controlled scenarios, browser-native co-residency, a participant field study, public page loads, and mitigation policies. Our framework separates measurements: controlled scenarios support leakage, boundary, and mitigation claims; participant runs support deployment, compatibility, and fingerprintability; and a Tranco crawl measures WebGPU exposure in real-world pages. Our controlled results identify persistent pipeline compilation state as the clearest surface. Cold/warm pipeline probes reveal prior compilation state across selected origin, profile, and browser placements. Controlled browser/native experiments also show native GPU activity can be inferred from browser-visible observables under labeled workloads. Other resource probes provide weaker positive results and negative controls. The participant field study shows active WebGPU behavior is highly distinctive within the sample, with deterministic components stable within runs and lower exact stability across repeated visits. A page-load crawl finds WebGPU use mainly as adapter probing and static support code, with no observed page-load shader, pipeline, queue, query, or map activity. Mitigation pilots identify source-level key separation as a proxy for evaluating pipeline-cache partitioning. Overall, WGPULens shows that WebGPU privacy analysis must be surface-specific: browsers need to measure which GPU state crosses which boundary, which browser-visible signals reveal it, and what the corresponding mitigations cost.

llm_summary.summary_zh: WebGPU 是一种允许普通网页通过经过验证的编程模型运行 GPU 工作负载的 Web API，其验证机制保证了内存安全，但共享的浏览器、驱动、操作系统和 GPU 状态仍可能暴露与隐私相关的信号。本文提出了 WGPULens 框架，用于在控制场景、浏览器原生共驻留、参与者实地研究、公共页面加载以及缓解策略等多个维度测量这些信号。框架将测量分为三类：控制实验支持泄露、边界和缓解声明；参与者运行支持部署、兼容性和指纹识别；Tranco 爬虫测量真实世界网页中的 WebGPU 暴露情况。控制实验结果发现，持久性管道编译状态是最清晰的暴露面：冷/热管道探测可以揭示先前跨选中源、配置文件和浏览器位置的编译状态。浏览器/原生共驻留实验还表明，在标记的工作负载下，可以从浏览器可见的观察量推断原生 GPU 活动。其他资源探测提供了较弱的阳性结果和阴性对照。参与者实地研究显示，样本中的活跃 WebGPU 行为具有高度区分性，其确定性组件在运行内稳定，而跨重复访问的精确稳定性较低。页面加载爬虫发现 WebGPU 主要用于适配器探测和静态支持代码，未观察到页面加载着色器、管道、队列、查询或映射活动。缓解试点表明，源级别密钥分离可以作为评估管道缓存分区的代理。总体而言，WGPULens 表明 WebGPU 隐私分析必须针对特定表面：浏览器需要测量哪些 GPU 状态跨越了哪些边界、哪些浏览器可见信号揭示了这些状态，以及相应缓解措施的成本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: WebGPU 是下一代 Web 图形和计算 API，其隐私影响尚未被充分研究。本文首次系统测量了 WebGPU 的隐私泄露面，为浏览器厂商和 Web 应用开发者提供了关键的基线数据与缓解方向。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用 WebGPU 的浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 等）以及依赖 GPU 加速的 Web 应用；可能被用于用户指纹识别或跨上下文追踪。
detection_signals_zh: 冷/暖管道编译时间差异
浏览器可见的 GPU 状态变化（如适配器属性）
defense_advice_zh: 实现源级别的管道缓存分区（如密钥分离）
限制 WebGPU 接口返回的时间精度
对 GPU 编译状态引入随机延迟或噪声

items.title: Lessons from the Adoption and Deprecation of the Privacy Sandbox Web APIs
items.summary: While several web actors have been trying to reduce web tracking for years, it remains unclear how to achieve both desirable levels of utility and privacy. In 2019, Google launched the Privacy Sandbox initiative to balance that trade-off and find privacy alternatives to common use cases such as advertising. Yet, in late 2025, Google canceled the project and deprecated most of the newly introduced APIs. Despite its end, the Privacy Sandbox represents a unique opportunity to learn about how the ecosystem reacted to the proposed changes and make observations about why and how it failed. In this paper, we present a longitudinal measurement and analysis study of the Privacy Sandbox APIs to characterize their adoption and deprecation over the past seven years by different web actors. Leveraging historical HTTP Archive crawls and public Chrome telemetry data, we offer the largest study of its kind into the prevalence of each Privacy Sandbox feature, during their entire respective lifetime (5+ years for some), on popular websites (CrUX top 100k), and as experienced by Chrome users during their browsing journey. Our results showcase an adoption that remained limited and uneven across the years; only few web actors implemented very specific APIs, and in disparate manners. We motivate our interpretation of these results by considering the incentives (interest, resources, timeline, etc.) and risks (potential trade-offs, privacy violations, and legal exposure, etc.) for these actors. Finally, our analysis also yields actionable recommendations for the next generation of web privacy proposals. More broadly, the Privacy Sandbox illustrates the limitations and disparities across browsers of ``fix it in the browser'' remedies: today, tracking and third-party cookies limitations in Chrome still remain largely opt-in, while they have been enabled by default on other browsers like Brave, Firefox, or Safari.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对Google Privacy Sandbox（隐私沙盒）Web API的采用与弃用进行了长达七年的纵向测量与分析。Privacy Sandbox旨在通过引入新的Web API（如Topics API、FLEDGE等）来替代第三方Cookie，在保护用户隐私的同时维持广告等用例的效用。然而，Google于2025年底取消了该项目并弃用了大部分新API。研究利用HTTP Archive爬取数据和Chrome遥测数据，对CrUX排名前10万的网站进行了全生命周期跟踪（部分API超过5年）。结果发现，这些API的采用率始终有限且不均衡：只有少数Web参与者实现了特定API，且实现方式各异。论文从激励（兴趣、资源、时间线）和风险（潜在权衡、隐私违规、法律暴露）角度解释了这一现象，并提出了下一代Web隐私提案的可行建议。更广泛地，Privacy Sandbox暴露了“在浏览器中修复”方案的局限性：Chrome中跟踪和第三方Cookie的限制至今仍主要是选择加入，而Brave、Firefox、Safari等浏览器已默认启用。该研究为Web隐私政策制定者和浏览器开发者提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了大型浏览器隐私倡议的失败原因及生态系统采纳的障碍，为未来Web隐私设计提供实证教训。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Web隐私标准制定、浏览器厂商决策、广告技术行业策略，可迁移至任何涉及浏览器API与隐私权衡的场景。

items.title: Query Cost Model Calibration in Confidential Virtual Machines
items.summary: With the growing adoption of Confidential Computing, running databases in confidential virtual machines (CVMs) such as AMD SEV-SNP has become an attractive way to protect sensitive cloud data with minimal changes to legacy DBMSs. However, analytical queries in such CVMs often suffer substantial overhead, and prior database work has largely stopped at benchmarking these slowdowns rather than optimizing them. We show that this problem stems from a hardware-software mismatch: query optimizers still rely on KVM-oriented (non-encrypted VM) cost assumptions that no longer hold in CVMs. To address this, we propose a lightweight CVM-aware cost calibration. It models two dominant sources of optimizer-facing overhead: data movement and RMP-related translation using simple physical proxies already available to the optimizer. Experiments show that the calibration significantly narrows the KVM/CVM performance gap, recovering up to 48 percent performance and even outperforming the KVM baseline on some workloads.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对在机密虚拟机（CVM）中运行数据库分析查询时遇到的显著性能开销问题展开研究。随着机密计算技术的普及，像AMD SEV-SNP这样的CVM能够以最小改动保护云数据库中的敏感数据，但分析查询在CVM中相比传统虚拟机（如KVM）存在巨大的性能损失。以往研究主要停留在基准测试阶段，未深入优化。本文指出，问题的根源在于硬件与软件的不匹配：查询优化器仍沿用基于KVM（非加密虚拟机）的成本模型假设，而这些假设在CVM中已不再成立。为此，作者提出一种轻量级的CVM感知成本校准方法。该方法通过优化器可直接使用的简单物理代理，建模了两种主要优化器端开销来源：数据移动（data movement）和与RMP（Reverse Map Table）相关的地址转换开销。校准过程无需修改硬件或内核，仅调整优化器的成本估算参数。实验结果表明，校准后显著缩小了KVM与CVM之间的性能差距，最多可恢复48%的性能，部分工作负载甚至超越了KVM基线。本文适合数据库系统研究人员、查询优化开发人员以及机密计算安全从业者阅读，为后续在CVM中设计高效查询引擎提供了实用指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了机密虚拟化环境与经典优化器假设之间的根本矛盾，并提出低成本、可落地的校准方案，对保护云数据隐私的同时保障查询性能具有直接意义。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了机密虚拟化环境与经典优化器假设之间的根本矛盾，并提出低成本、可落地的校准方案，对保护云数据隐私的同时保障查询性能具有直接意义。

items.title: Verifying Intent and Harm: A Unified Defense Against LLM-Generated Threats
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in interactive applications, yet they remain vulnerable to adversarial interactions that induce harmful, deceptive, or policy-violating outputs. Existing defenses typically analyze either user prompts or generated outputs, but not both. However, many real-world attacks exploit a separation between adversarial intent expressed in the prompt and actionable harm manifested only in the response. As a result, prompt-only and response-only defenses frequently miss unsafe interactions that appear benign when viewed from either side in isolation. We present a verification-centric defense framework that jointly evaluates prompt intent and response harm before an LLM response is delivered to a user. The framework employs specialized analysts for intent and harm assessment together with a Judge for conflict resolution. We formalize a threat model for prompt-response attacks and evaluate the framework across five threat categories: jailbreaks, prompt injection, phishing, cyber abuse, and harmful content. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that jointly verifying prompt intent and response harm consistently outperforms single-sided defenses and single-agent reasoning baselines. Across threat categories, the framework improves average F1 from 0.90 for the strongest applicable baselines to 0.95 while reducing the average attack success rate to 4.1 percent. Compared with a Single-Agent+CoT baseline, it improves average F1 from 0.87 to 0.95 and reduces the false positive rate on benign-sensitive requests from 0.12 to 0.06. We further evaluate architecture-aware adaptive attacks in which the attacker knows the verifier structure and attempts to bypass individual verification components. Our results suggest that prompt-response verification provides a practical foundation for securing LLM applications against evolving adversarial threats.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在交互式应用中部署日益广泛，但仍易受到对抗性交互的影响，导致产生有害、欺骗性或违反政策的输出。现有防御通常仅分析用户提示（prompt）或生成输出（response），但许多实际攻击利用了提示中的对抗意图与响应中可操作危害之间的分离，导致单侧防御常常遗漏看似无害的交互。为此，本文提出一种以验证为中心的防御框架，在LLM响应交付给用户之前，联合评估提示意图和响应危害。该框架采用专门的分析器分别评估意图和危害，并设立一个裁决器（Judge）进行冲突解决。作者形式化了提示-响应攻击的威胁模型，并在五种威胁类别（越狱、提示注入、钓鱼、网络滥用和有害内容）上评估了框架。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，联合验证提示意图和响应危害始终优于单侧防御和单智能体推理基线。在所有威胁类别上，该框架将平均F1分数从最强基线的0.90提升至0.95，同时将平均攻击成功率降至4.1%。与单智能体+思维链基线相比，平均F1从0.87提升至0.95，对良性敏感请求的误报率从0.12降至0.06。此外，作者还评估了架构感知的自适应攻击，其中攻击者知晓验证器结构并试图绕过单个验证组件。结果表明，提示-响应验证为保护LLM应用免受不断演变的对抗性威胁提供了实用基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作首次系统性地联合验证提示意图与响应危害，显著优于现有单侧防御方法，为LLM应用安全提供了可落地的防御框架。

items.why_it_matters: 该工作首次系统性地联合验证提示意图与响应危害，显著优于现有单侧防御方法，为LLM应用安全提供了可落地的防御框架。

items.title: Hybrid privacy-aware semantic search: SVD-truncated document geometry and CKKS-encrypted query reranking under a restricted threat model
items.summary: Dense embeddings power semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation, but embedding-inversion attacks can reconstruct source text from a vector: when a vector database leaks, the documents behind it leak too. The textbook defences are extremes - encrypting the whole search homomorphically is sound but too slow at million-document scale, while privacy noise degrades ranking long before it protects. We study a middle path exploiting the asymmetry between the static collection and the dynamic query. The collection is protected geometrically: each vector is truncated onto a lower-dimensional SVD subspace and rotated by a secret orthogonal transform known only to the owner. The query is protected cryptographically: it is reranked under CKKS homomorphic encryption, so an honest-but-curious server never sees the query or the scores. CKKS parameters come from a small offline benchmark. We prove a tight lower bound on the reconstruction error of any attacker confined to the protected subspace. On one million documents and five encoders the scheme preserves ranking quality (slightly improving it on strong encoders, as a linear denoiser) at sub-second latency, and an off-the-shelf inversion attack on the protected space collapses to the noise floor. We then test stronger adversaries: a known-plaintext attacker recovers the rotation by orthogonal Procrustes from about as many leaked pairs as the retained dimension; the public product-quantization codes preserve most nearest-neighbour structure; and random-projection, calibrated-noise and BEIR baselines show the truncation is an encoder-dependent accuracy cost, not a free denoiser. We state the limits: query confidentiality is cryptographic, but document protection is an empirical obfuscation layer (SVD truncation plus a secret rotation), not a cryptographic primitive, and we delimit the threat model for each claim.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合隐私感知语义搜索方法，旨在解决密集嵌入向量泄露导致的文档重构攻击问题。传统防御手段包括完全同态加密（安全但速度慢）和添加隐私噪声（影响排序质量）。作者利用静态文档集合与动态查询之间的不对称性，设计了一种折中方案：文档集合通过几何保护，即每个向量被截断到低维SVD子空间，并应用文档所有者独有的秘密正交变换进行旋转；查询则通过CKKS同态加密进行重排序保护，使得诚实但好奇的服务器无法获取查询向量或分数。CKKS参数通过离线的基准测试确定。论文严格证明了在受限子空间内攻击者的重构误差下界。在100万个文档和五种不同编码器上的实验表明，该方案在亚秒级延迟下保持了排序质量（在强编码器上甚至略有提升，起到线性去噪作用），且现成的反演攻击在保护空间上退化到噪声水平。进一步测试了更强的攻击者：已知明文攻击者通过正交Procrustes方法，在泄露的配对数量与保留维度相当时即可恢复旋转；公用量化乘积码保留了大部分最近邻结构；随机投影、校准噪声和BEIR基线表明，截断是一种依赖于编码器的精度代价，而非免费去噪器。作者明确界定了各声称的威胁模型限制：查询机密性基于密码学保证，但文档保护属于经验性混淆层（SVD截断加秘密旋转），而非密码学原语。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文针对向量数据库泄露导致文档重构的重大安全风险，提出了一种实用且高效的混合隐私保护方案，平衡了安全性、效率和排序质量，对部署RAG或语义搜索服务的团队具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响语义搜索和检索增强生成系统的隐私保护设计，可迁移至任何依赖密集嵌入向量的信息检索场景，尤其是需要保护索引文档和查询隐私的部署环境。

items.why_it_matters: 本文针对向量数据库泄露导致文档重构的重大安全风险，提出了一种实用且高效的混合隐私保护方案，平衡了安全性、效率和排序质量，对部署RAG或语义搜索服务的团队具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Governing Actions, Not Agents: Institutional Attestation as a Governance Model for Autonomous AI Systems
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents may begin to perform consequential, irreversible actions such as clinical prescribing and production software deployment. This paper observes that human institutions have governed powerful autonomous actors not by monitoring their reasoning but by requiring independently attested evidence at the point of consequential action. We formalise this institutional pattern as a computational governance model for AI agent systems. Under the proposed model, an agent retains full autonomy over planning and reasoning but holds no execution authority over designated high-risk actions. Execution is conditional on preconditions that are each independently attested by a separate authoritative source, cryptographically bound to a declared intent, and evaluated by a deterministic policy. Decisions are recorded in a tamper-evident log amenable to independent re-verification. We present a proof-of-concept implementation and illustrate the model with examples from software deployment and clinical prescribing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对自主AI系统（如AI代理）的治理模型，核心思想是“治理行为而非治理代理”。作者观察到，人类机构在管理具有强大能力的自主行为者（如医生、工程师）时，并非直接监控其推理过程，而是在关键行动点要求独立的、可验证的凭证。受此启发，论文将此模式形式化为一个计算治理框架：AI代理可以完全自主地规划和推理，但对指定高风险行动（如临床开药、生产软件部署）的执行权限受到约束。执行的条件是每个前提条件由独立的权威来源独立认证，并与声明的意图进行密码学绑定，由确定性策略进行评估。所有决策记录在防篡改日志中，可独立重新验证。论文给出了概念验证实现，并举例说明了在软件部署和临床处方场景下的应用。该研究为构建可问责的自主AI系统提供了新的架构思路，特别适合关注AI安全治理、可审计性及责任归属的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文提出了一种实用的AI代理治理模型，在不牺牲自主性的前提下引入独立认证和可审计日志，对蓝队设计安全可控的AI系统具有重要参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: 该论文提出了一种实用的AI代理治理模型，在不牺牲自主性的前提下引入独立认证和可审计日志，对蓝队设计安全可控的AI系统具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Beyond Takedown: Measuring Malicious Go Module Persistence in the Wild
items.summary: We measure an automation-based supply chain campaign in the Go ecosystem. The attackers repackage legitimate Go modules under attacker-controlled owners, and embed them with obfuscated code for an import-triggered downloader. Our results come from two complementary analyses: a) a manual search on GitHub across 2,113 repositories and b) a large-scale scan of 12.3M index entries using a deobfuscating AST scanner (GOAST) that we implemented. As a result, we identified 2,289 malicious versions of legitimate Go modules. We demonstrate that purely GitHub-centric searches fail to identify the full extent of the compromise and are only effective for as long as the affected code is present on the platform. Moreover, our proxy-based measurements of the takedown-remediation gap reveal that among artifacts later found to be GitHub-unobservable (i.e., removed or suspended), at least 99.4% remained retrievable via Go proxy. Following our disclosure, GitHub has removed 684 malicious repositories and the Google Go team has remediated 1,377 module versions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文测量了Go生态系统中的一种自动化供应链攻击。攻击者将合法的Go模块重新打包到其控制下的所有者账户中，并嵌入混淆代码作为导入触发的下载器。研究者通过两种互补分析方法进行测量：一是对GitHub上2,113个仓库进行手动搜索；二是使用自实现的去混淆AST扫描器（GOAST）对12,300万个索引条目进行大规模扫描。结果识别出2,289个合法Go模块的恶意版本。研究表明，仅以GitHub为中心的搜索无法完全识别攻击范围，且仅在受影响代码仍然存在于平台上时才有效。此外，通过代理基线的测量发现，在后续被判定为GitHub不可观察（即已移除或暂停）的工件中，至少99.4%仍然可以通过Go代理检索到。在研究者披露后，GitHub移除了684个恶意仓库，Google Go团队修复了1,377个模块版本。该工作揭示了当前供应链安全措施（如下架）的局限性，即恶意模块的持久性远超平台可见范围。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了下架机制在供应链安全中的盲区：即使从GitHub删除，恶意Go模块仍可通过官方代理持续传播，极大延长了攻击窗口，对依赖管理提出新挑战。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Go生态系统所有使用Go proxy的模块使用者；攻击者可利用持久性长期维持恶意模块的可达性，绕过传统下架响应。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 评估内部Go模块依赖策略，考虑定期清理代理缓存并监控异常模块版本。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了下架机制在供应链安全中的盲区：即使从GitHub删除，恶意Go模块仍可通过官方代理持续传播，极大延长了攻击窗口，对依赖管理提出新挑战。

items.title: TEMPO-Diffusion: Temporally Exposed Malicious Poisoning of Diffusion Models
items.summary: Noise-based backdoor attacks on diffusion models typically rely on input-time trigger injection, untargeted activation, and out-of-distribution target generation. Such assumptions reduce both the stealthiness and the practical relevance of these attacks. In this work, we present TEMPO-Diffusion, a targeted backdoor framework that localizes the malicious distribution shift to a temporal, in-distribution exposure. TEMPO-Diffusion supports: (i) targeted attacks on and to specific classes, (ii) multiple sub-image backdoors that reconstruct specific features within multiple, different output images and at multiple locations, and (iii) in-painting with time-conditioned triggers. To study relevant, practical security concerns in leveraging backdoored diffusion models for synthetic training data, we also introduce CALISA: a balanced, region-aware traffic-sign dataset emphasizing Canadian and U.S. road signs. Across CIFAR10, GTSRB, and CALISA, our experiments show that TEMPO-Diffusion can reliably poison class-specific synthetic data generation and induce high attack success rates in downstream classifiers trained on that data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对扩散模型的新型后门攻击框架 TEMPO-Diffusion。传统的基于噪声的后门攻击通常依赖于输入时触发注入、非目标激活以及分布外目标生成，这些假设降低了攻击的隐蔽性和实际相关性。TEMPO-Diffusion 将恶意分布偏移限制在时间性、分布内暴露中，支持三类攻击：针对特定类别的定向攻击、多子图像后门（在多个输出图像的不同位置重建特定特征），以及利用时间条件触发器的图像修复。为了研究使用带后门的扩散模型生成合成训练数据所带来的实际安全问题，作者还引入了 CALISA 数据集——一个平衡的、区域感知的交通标志数据集，重点关注加拿大和美国的道路标志。实验在 CIFAR-10、GTSRB 和 CALISA 三个数据集上进行，结果表明 TEMPO-Diffusion 能够可靠地毒化特定类别的合成数据生成，并在基于这些数据训练的下游分类器中诱导高攻击成功率。该研究揭示了扩散模型在数据增强场景下的安全风险，为后续防御研究提供了基准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 扩散模型被广泛用于生成合成训练数据，该研究表明此类模型可能被植入隐蔽后门，导致下游分类器在特定条件下失效，对依赖合成数据的系统构成实际威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用扩散模型生成训练数据的机器学习管道，尤其是自动驾驶等安全关键领域中基于图像分类的任务。

items.title: Expecting (Targeted Ads)? Network Analysis of User Health Data Leakage in Fertility Tracking Apps
items.summary: While human factors in the privacy of fertility tracking apps -- health trackers that record user's menstrual or pregnancy data -- has been the subject of extensive study, little attention has been paid to the technical aspects of apps' data handling practices. We conduct a network-based measurement study of a corpus of 20 Android fertility tracking apps from the Google Play Store, focusing on how user data is shared with third party advertising services. After systematizing app features, we conduct a series of standardized user interactions across all apps in an environment that records TLS-stripped network traffic. In a subset of apps (n=5) we identify explicit leakage of user health data as well implicit leakage through highly targeted contextual advertising URL's. Equally importantly, we observe additional apps that use an ad-based monetization model without apparent leakage of user data, as well as several apps the interact only minimally with ad services. These findings provide technical grounding for widespread user concerns, but also underscore the importance of consumer choice in the privacy implications of app-based fertility tracking.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对生育追踪应用（fertility tracking apps）中用户健康数据的隐私泄露问题进行了基于网络测量的研究。以往研究多关注用户隐私态度等人因因素，而技术层面的数据实践关注不足。作者从Google Play商店选取了20款Android生育追踪应用，通过系统化特征分析后，在可控环境中执行标准化用户交互，并记录TLS剥离后的网络流量。研究发现，在5款应用中存在显式的用户健康数据泄露（如直接将敏感标签发送给广告服务），以及通过高度精准的上下文广告URL造成的隐式泄露。同时，也有部分应用采用广告变现模式但未观察到明显数据泄露，以及一些应用与广告服务交互极少。研究结论为用户的普遍担忧提供了技术依据，并强调了消费者选择在应用隐私影响中的重要性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了生育追踪应用中未经用户同意的健康数据流向广告商的具体技术路径，为隐私监管和用户选择提供实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用生育追踪应用的用户隐私，尤其涉及敏感健康数据；研究方法可迁移至其他健康类App的隐私评估。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了生育追踪应用中未经用户同意的健康数据流向广告商的具体技术路径，为隐私监管和用户选择提供实证依据。

items.title: CyberChainBench: Can AI Agents Secure Smart Contracts Against Real-World On-Chain Vulnerabilities?
items.summary: We present CyberChainBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on smart contract security across three complementary tasks: vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and patch synthesis. Built from 541 real-world exploit incidents from DeFiHackLabs spanning 9 EVM chains, the benchmark provides end-to-end on-chain evaluation where agents interact with historical blockchain state through isolated evaluation environments orchestrated by Harbor, using tools to read code, trace transactions, and validate exploits on mainnet forks. Each case is anchored to a specific block and includes structured ground truth covering vulnerability type, localization, and attacker profit. Exploits are graded by economic impact on historical forks; patches are validated by replaying historical attacks and legitimate transactions as fail-to-pass test oracles on a proxy-upgradeable subset. We define a five-type vulnerability taxonomy and evaluate multiple agent--model configurations. Results reveal a clear difficulty gradient: the best configuration scores 37.5% on detection, 43.7% on exploitation, but only 23.4% on patching, with the top agent (Codex with GPT-5.5) realizing \$57.4M in total exploit profit across the 200-case exploit set at a cost of $2.39 per case.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了 CyberChainBench，一个用于评估基于 LLM 的智能合约安全代理的基准测试。该基准涵盖三个互补任务：漏洞检测、漏洞利用生成和补丁合成。它基于 DeFiHackLabs 收集的 541 个真实世界漏洞事件，跨越 9 条 EVM 链。每个案例锚定到特定区块，并包含结构化真实数据（漏洞类型、定位、攻击者利润）。评估环境使用 Harbor 编排的隔离环境，允许代理通过工具读取代码、追踪交易并在主网分叉上验证利用。漏洞利用根据历史分叉上的经济影响分级；补丁通过重放历史攻击和合法交易作为失败-通过测试预言机在代理可升级子集上验证。论文定义了五种漏洞分类，并评估了多种代理-模型配置。结果显示难度梯度明显：最佳配置在检测上得分为 37.5%，漏洞利用为 43.7%，补丁仅为 23.4%。顶级代理（Codex 搭配 GPT-5.5）在 200 个案例的利用套件中实现了总计 5740 万美元的利用利润，每案例成本为 2.39 美元。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准为评估 AI 代理在智能合约安全中的实际能力提供了标准化测试平台，帮助安全团队了解当前 LLM 在自动化漏洞检测、利用和修复中的局限性，对 Defi 安全评估和自动化防御工具有指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响以太坊及 EVM 兼容链的智能合约安全评估流程，可迁移到其他区块链平台的合约安全测试场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：安全团队可参考其评估方法论，评估内部 LLM 安全代理方案的效果，并关注该基准后续扩展。

items.title: Data Facts: A Metadata Schema for Structured Data Exchange in the NANDini Multi-Agent Ecosystem
items.summary: NANDini (Networked Agents Natural Distillation of Interconnected Nodal Intelligence) envisions an automated ecosystem where intelligent agents independently create, process, and exchange data to drive decisions at scale. Realizing this vision requires infrastructure beyond agent discovery and communication: agents must be able to advertise, evaluate, and verify the datasets they hold. Current protocols, including NANDA for federated registry and A2A and MCP for inter-agent messaging, address identity and communication but provide no mechanism for structured data exchange. Existing enterprise data-sharing frameworks, such as IDS-RAM, Gaia-X, and Ocean Protocol, assume human-in-the-loop governance that is incompatible with autonomous, real-time agent interactions. We introduce Data Facts, a core NANDini concept: a lightweight JSON metadata schema that bridges agent discovery and data access through a single pointer, `data_facts_url`, added to an existing Agent Facts registry record. The linked document encodes dataset identity, access tier, whether public, semi-private, or private, endpoint, a time-to-live for freshness validation, and a SHA-256 integrity checksum. For private and semi-private data, we implement a three-layer security pipeline: JWT authentication, capability-scoped gateway authorization, and an A2A credential delegation protocol. Across 840 decision-making evaluations, data-informed agents achieve 100% accuracy versus 35.2% without data access (p < 0.001); TTL enforcement reduces stale-data errors from 37.6% to 8.8%; checksum verification achieves 100% corruption detection at all injection rates; and the security pipeline blocks all 46 forgery attempts with zero data leakage.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Data Facts的轻量级JSON元数据模式，旨在解决多智能体生态系统NANDINI中智能体之间结构化数据交换的难题。NANDINI设想一个由智能体自动创建、处理和交换数据的生态系统，但现有协议（如NANDA、A2A、MCP）仅关注身份和通信，缺乏数据描述机制。企业级数据共享框架（如IDS-RAM、Gaia-X、Ocean Protocol）假设人机协同治理，不适用于自主实时交互。Data Facts通过向Agent Facts注册记录添加单一指针`data_facts_url`，将智能体发现与数据访问桥接起来。该链接文档编码了数据集身份、访问层级（公共、半私有、私有）、端点、用于新鲜度验证的生存时间（TTL）以及SHA-256完整性校验和。对于私有和半私有数据，实现了三层安全管道：JWT认证、能力范围网关授权和A2A凭证委托协议。实验评估显示：在840次决策评估中，拥有数据的智能体准确率达100%，而无数据访问时仅为35.2%（p<0.001）；TTL强制将过期数据错误从37.6%降至8.8%；校验和验证在所有注入率下实现100%的腐败检测；安全管道阻止了全部46次伪造尝试，且无数据泄露。该工作为自主智能体间的可信数据交换提供了标准化方案，对需要实时数据共享的多智能体系统（如物联网、金融交易、医疗协作）具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为多智能体系统提供了标准化数据交换方案，解决了自主智能体间数据发现、验证和访问控制的空白，尤其适用于需要实时可靠数据协作的场景，如AI驱动决策系统。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对构建可扩展的多智能体数据市场、自动化数据管道及跨组织数据共享有潜在影响，可迁移至物联网、云原生计算、联邦学习等需要结构化数据交换的领域。

items.title: The Unfireable Safety Kernel: Execution-Time AI Alignment for AI Agents and Other Escapable AI Systems
items.summary: AI agents are granted access to tools, APIs, and other infrastructure, making them active principals in those systems. The dominant approach places controls inside the agent's own runtime: system prompts, output filters, and guardrail libraries. Any control in the agent's address space is reachable by inputs that influence it; this generalizes to any AI system with sufficient reach into its own runtime, a class we term escapable AI systems. We identify four properties that an authorization mechanism must satisfy for architectural control rather than for cooperative requests: process separation, pre-action enforcement on a structurally only path, fail-closed at both the request and system levels, and externalized signed evidence verifiable outside the controlled system's trust boundary. We position this layer as execution-time AI alignment, complementing training-time alignment (RLHF, Constitutional AI) and inference-time alignment. We present the Unfireable Safety Kernel, a Rust reference implementation realizing all four. Its fail-closed invariant is machine-checked at two levels: an SMT theorem (Z3) and an exhaustive bounded-model-checking proof of the production decision function (Kani, 4/4 harnesses). A Python-to-Rust migration was gated on byte-equivalence (1000/1000 fixtures; 17/17 adversarial classes). We evaluate the kernel governing a live, escapable AI system, a deterministic, self-improving world model, against an escape-seeking adversary driving its real self-modification seam: across 1,000 self-modifications, all 704 attempts on the safety-critical core are refused, with no escape; a further 300, under the operator kill switch, are also refused. A separate campaign of 6,240 authorization round-trips had no successful bypass. Against 3 contemporary systems claiming the agent control plane, the agent invokes control; here, it lacks that choice.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文提出了一种针对 AI 智能体（Agent）及其他“可逃脱”AI 系统的执行时安全内核（Unfireable Safety Kernel）。当前主流安全控制方法（如系统提示、输出过滤、防护栏库）均内置于智能体的运行时环境中，这使得攻击者可以通过输入影响这些控制机制，从而绕过安全限制。作者将这类系统定义为“可逃脱 AI 系统”，即那些对其自身运行时具有足够控制力的 AI 系统。为了解决这一问题，论文提出了架构级授权机制必须满足的四个属性：进程隔离（将安全决策与智能体运行时分离）、在唯一路径上进行动作前强制（即在动作执行前进行拦截）、请求级和系统级的故障关闭（fail-closed，即默认拒绝）、以及外部化签名证据（可在受控系统信任边界外验证）。作者将这些机制定位为“执行时 AI 对齐”，与训练时对齐（RLHF、Constitutional AI）和推理时对齐互补。他们用 Rust 实现了该安全内核，并通过 SMT 定理（Z3）和全面边界模型检验（Kani）从机器层面验证了故障关闭不变性。实验部分：在真实的可逃脱 AI 系统（一个确定性自改进世界模型）上，面对试图利用系统自我修改接口的逃逸对手，进行了 1000 次自我修改尝试，其中所有 704 次针对安全关键核心的尝试均被拒绝，没有发生逃逸；另外 300 次在操作员终止开关下的尝试也被拒绝。此外，6240 次授权往返测试未发现任何成功绕过。与三个声称控制智能体控制平面的当代系统相比，本方案中的智能体没有选择权，即无法绕过安全控制。该论文适合 AI 安全研究员、AI 系统架构师及安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种全新的架构级AI安全范式，将安全控制与AI系统运行时彻底分离，并通过形式化验证保证故障关闭属性，为防御Agent逃逸攻击提供了可证明有效的解决方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何接入外部工具、API或基础设施的AI智能体系统，尤其适合高风险自动化场景（如自主交易、网络操作）。

items.why_it_matters: 提出了一种全新的架构级AI安全范式，将安全控制与AI系统运行时彻底分离，并通过形式化验证保证故障关闭属性，为防御Agent逃逸攻击提供了可证明有效的解决方案。

items.title: Detect, Unlearn, Restore: Defending Text Summarization Models Against Data Poisoning
items.summary: Training-time data poisoning during fine-tuning poses a significant threat to large language models (LLMs) deployed for abstractive text summarization, where small task-specific datasets exert disproportionate influence on model behavior. In this setting, adversaries manipulate fine-tuning data to induce persistent summarization failures, such as biased or harmful summaries, while preserving standard evaluation metrics. We present a unified post-hoc defense framework for detecting and remediating fine-tuning-stage poisoning in summarization models across the machine learning supply chain. Our experiments show that in white-box settings, poisoned document-summary pairs exhibit abnormally high training influence, enabling detection via influence-function analysis with semantic consistency checks. In black-box settings, poisoned models display two to three times greater sensitivity to semantics-preserving perturbations, enabling behavioral auditing without training data access. Beyond existing poisoning formulations, we introduce novel attacks targeting factual distortion and representational bias, showing that poisoning alters summarization behavior without triggering conventional alarms. Across nine architectures and six benchmark datasets under adaptive attacks, our defenses achieve 85-92% detection precision, while gradient-ascent unlearning restores up to 96% of original behavior with minimal utility loss (less than 0.6% ROUGE degradation). These results indicate that fine-tuning-time poisoning leaves persistent structural artifacts, enabling practical detection and post-deployment recovery without full retraining.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在抽象文本摘要微调阶段面临的数据投毒攻击，提出了一套统一的防御框架。研究动机在于，微调时使用的任务特定数据集规模较小，攻击者可以通过操纵微调数据植入后门，导致模型生成有偏或有害的摘要，同时保持标准评估指标（如ROUGE）正常。现有防御多针对分类模型，对生成式摘要模型的适用性有限。作者首先提出了两种新型攻击：事实扭曲攻击（使摘要包含错误事实）和表征偏置攻击（使摘要偏向特定群体或观点），证明了传统检测方法难以发现这些攻击。然后，设计了一套后验防御方案，包含检测和恢复两个阶段。在白盒场景（可访问训练数据）下，利用影响函数分析结合语义一致性检查，识别异常高影响力的文档-摘要对，检测精度达85-92%。在黑盒场景（仅可查询模型）下，通过语义保持扰动（如同义替换）检测模型敏感性异常，发现被投毒模型的扰动敏感性是正常模型的2-3倍，从而实现行为审计。恢复阶段采用梯度上升遗忘技术，仅移除投毒样本的影响，模型原始行为恢复率高达96%，且ROUGE指标下降不足0.6%，无需完整重训练。实验覆盖9种架构（包括BART、T5、Pegasus等）和6个基准数据集（如CNN/DailyMail、XSum等），并针对自适应攻击（攻击者知晓防御策略）进行了评估。结果表明，微调阶段的投毒会在模型参数中留下持久的结构性痕迹，从而为实际部署后的检测与修复提供了可能。本文适合LLM安全研究者、模型供应链安全工程师以及关注数据投毒防御的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次聚焦文本摘要模型的微调数据投毒防御，提出可落地的检测与恢复方案，填补了生成式NLP安全领域的重要空白，对保护LLM供应链安全具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 防御方法可迁移到其他序列生成任务（如机器翻译、对话生成），并启发后续针对LLM微调投毒的检测与遗忘研究。
detection_signals_zh: 白盒：训练样本的影响函数值异常高，且语义一致性检查不通过
黑盒：模型对语义保持扰动的输出敏感性显著增大（2-3倍）
defense_advice_zh: 部署阶段记录训练数据的影响函数，定期审计高影响样本
对微调后的模型实施黑盒敏感性测试，发现异常立即回滚并执行遗忘
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估该方法在自有模型和场景下的效果，并考虑集成到MLOps流水线中。

items.title: The Role of Input Dimensionality in the Emergence and Targeted Control of Adversarial Examples
items.summary: Several theoretical works have tried to explain the adversarial vulnerability of deep neural networks through properties of high-dimensional geometry. However, the assumptions underlying these works are rarely examined empirically, and systematic evidence remains limited. In this work, we present a systematic study of the role of input dimensionality in both the emergence and the targeted control of adversarial examples. We first analyse the scope and limitations of existing theoretical frameworks based on concentration of measure, showing that real image classes exhibit strong empirical localization, beyond what such theories typically assume. We then conduct an extensive empirical evaluation across hierarchical image datasets spanning a wide range of input dimensionalities and diverse neural architectures. Our results consistently show that adversarial examples become easier to construct as dimensionality increases. We also investigate how input dimensionality affects the additional difficulty of crafting targeted adversarial examples. In particular, we provide theoretical arguments showing that high-dimensional geometry implies that enforcing a specific target label entails only a limited additional distortion compared to untargeted attacks. We corroborate this insight through extensive experiments, demonstrating that the gap between targeted and untargeted perturbations remains small and further narrows as input dimensionality increases. While, taken together, our findings establish high input dimensionality as a fundamental factor underlying the emergence and targeted control of adversarial examples, whether this phenomenon primarily arises from the interplay between high-dimensional geometry and data distributions or from the architectural properties of deep neural networks remains an open question.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统研究了输入维度在对抗样本的产生与定向控制中的作用。现有理论工作常利用高维几何性质解释深度神经网络的对抗脆弱性，但缺乏系统的实证验证。作者首先分析了基于测度集中（concentration of measure）的现有理论框架的适用范围与局限性，发现真实图像类别表现出强的经验局部性，超出了理论假设。随后，他们跨越广泛输入维度的分层图像数据集和多种神经网络架构进行了大量实验。结果一致显示：随着维度增加，对抗样本更易构造。研究进一步探索了输入维度对定向对抗样本额外难度的影响，通过理论论证指出高维几何特性意味着与无目标攻击相比，强制指定目标标签仅需有限的额外扰动。大量实验证实了这一见解：定向与非定向扰动之间的差距很小，且随维度增加进一步缩小。综合而言，高输入维度是对抗样本产生与定向控制的基础因素，但该现象主要源于高维几何与数据分布的相互作用，还是深度神经网络的架构特性，仍有待解答。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究从理论上和实验上证实高输入维度是导致对抗样本易于产生和定向控制的重要因素，有助于安全从业者理解对抗攻击的根本机制，为设计更鲁棒的模型提供理论指导。

items.title: Can Trustless Agents Be Trusted? An Empirical Study of the ERC-8004 Decentralized AI Agent Ecosystem
items.summary: As autonomous AI agents increasingly transact across organizational boundaries, a fundamental trust challenge emerges: how can an agent assess whether an unknown counterpart is trustworthy? The ERC-8004 protocol addresses this challenge with the first permissionless trust layer for AI agent economies, built around three on-chain registries for Identity, Reputation, and Validation. Despite its rapid adoption, the protocol has not been studied empirically, leaving it unclear whether the information it records provides a trustworthy basis for decision-making. To address this gap, we present the first empirical study of ERC-8004 across three chains: Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain (BSC), and Base, covering the period from protocol deployment through May 13, 2026. We crawl on-chain Identity and Reputation events, off-chain files, and x402 payment transactions. On the identity side, we find that most registrations are placeholders rather than active agents, with only a small fraction (3%, 4%, and 15% across Ethereum, BSC, and Base) exposing a valid ERC-8004 registration file with at least one live service endpoint. On the reputation side, we show that the Registry, as currently deployed, cannot function as a trust signal: values are not commensurable, feedback records are rarely grounded in verifiable interactions, and reputation can be manipulated at minimal cost. Consistent with these design weaknesses, we find that a substantial fraction of reviewers (73.6%, 59.2%, and 90.6% across Ethereum, BSC, and Base) exhibit coordinated Sybil behavior. After removing Sybil-flagged feedback, 15.5%, 72.3%, and 89.4% of rated agents, respectively, are left with no valid feedback. We then turn these findings into concrete recommendations for future revisions of ERC-8004. Our study yields actionable protocol-design implications and establishes an empirical baseline for research on AI agent markets.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对 ERC-8004 去中心化 AI 代理生态系统进行了首次实证研究。ERC-8004 是一个为 AI 代理经济设计的无需许可信任层，包含三个链上注册表：身份、声誉和验证。研究覆盖了 Ethereum、BNB Smart Chain (BSC) 和 Base 三条链，从协议部署到 2026 年 5 月 13 日的数据。通过爬取链上身份和声誉事件、链下文件和 x402 支付交易，研究人员发现：在身份方面，大多数注册是占位符而非活跃代理，只有很小比例（Ethereum 3%、BSC 4%、Base 15%）拥有有效的 ERC-8004 注册文件并至少有一个活跃服务端点。在声誉方面，当前部署的注册表不能作为信任信号——数值不可通约、反馈记录很少基于可验证的交互、声誉可以低成本操纵。与这些设计弱点一致，大量评审者表现出协调的女巫行为（Ethereum 73.6%、BSC 59.2%、Base 90.6%）。移除女巫标记的反馈后，分别有 15.5%、72.3% 和 89.4% 的代理没有有效反馈。最后，论文将这些发现转化为对 ERC-8004 未来修订的具体建议，为 AI 代理市场的研究建立了实证基线。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前去中心化 AI 代理信任基础设施的严重缺陷，表明声誉系统容易被女巫攻击操纵，对于开发或依赖自主代理间信任机制的团队具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响 ERC-8004 协议的后续版本设计，并可能迁移到其他基于区块链的代理声誉系统。

items.title: Privacy Vulnerabilities of Attention Layers in Tabular Foundation Models and Protection of High-Risk Queries
items.summary: Tabular foundation models are commonly assumed to present limited privacy concerns as they are often pre-trained on large collections of synthetic data. However, these models leverage in-context learning, where sensitive records may be provided directly at inference time as labelled context examples. In this paper, we demonstrate that predictions generated via the attention mechanism leak sufficient information to enable effective Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). To highlight this vulnerability, we propose AMIA (Attention-based Membership Inference Attack), a shadow-model-free attack that exploits the concentration of transformer attention patterns. Our results show that attention mechanisms reveal strong membership signals, which exceed classical confidence-based attacks, achieving an average gain of 7.7\%, specially in low false-positive regimes. To mitigate this risk, we introduce an inference-time defence inspired by $k$-anonymity principles. This approach reduces the uniqueness of context-key representations without introducing random noise or retraining the model. By targeting only high-risk queries identified through AMIA scores, the defence substantially reduces membership leakage of this attack by an average of 50\% and 25\% against confidence-based attacks, while preserving predictive utility with only 3.9\% performance degradation. Beyond showing that context examples are vulnerable, we further demonstrate that fine-tuning introduces an additional source of privacy risk. In particular, samples whose prediction confidence increases after fine-tuning become more susceptible to MIAs, indicating that fine-tuning can amplify memorisation and expose sensitive training information through confidence shifts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究表格基础模型（如 TabPFN）中注意力机制的隐私漏洞。虽然这类模型通常基于合成数据预训练，看似隐私风险较低，但在推理时，上下文学习（in-context learning）可能直接包含敏感记录作为标注示例。作者通过分析注意力机制的输出模式，提出了一种无需影子模型的成员推断攻击（AMIA），利用Transformer注意力分布的集中性来区分成员与非成员样本。实验表明，AMIA在低假阳性率下平均比传统基于置信度的攻击高出7.7个百分点，揭示了注意力机制泄露强成员信号。为缓解风险，论文借鉴k-匿名性原则，设计了一种推理时防御方法：通过降低上下文键表示的唯一性来减少成员信息泄露，无需添加随机噪声或重训练。该防御仅针对通过AMIA评分识别的高风险查询施行，能将AMIA攻击的成员泄露降低平均50%，对基于置信度的攻击降低25%，且模型预测性能仅下降3.9%。此外，论文还发现微调会引入额外隐私风险：微调后预测置信度增加的样本更容易受到成员推断攻击，表明微调可能加剧模型对训练数据的记忆。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 表格基础模型正被用于金融、医疗等敏感领域，本文首次揭示其注意力机制在上下文学习场景下的隐私漏洞，并提供了可兼得效用与隐私的实用防御方案，对推动安全部署具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用上下文学习的表格基础模型（如TabPFN），尤其在涉及个人数据的应用（如信用评估、疾病预测）中，成员推断攻击可能暴露训练集身份信息。
defense_advice_zh: 对高风险查询应用基于k-匿名性的推理时防御，通过降低上下文键表示的唯一性来抵御成员推断攻击。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估内部表格基础模型对此类攻击的暴露风险，并考虑集成所述防御机制。

items.title: MIRAGE: Protecting against Malicious Image Editing via False Moderation
items.summary: The proliferation of AI-powered image editing systems raises serious concerns because it allows personal images to be arbitrarily manipulated at scale, with minimal effort, and a lower barrier to entry. Prior work on image immunization adds imperceptible perturbations to an image to protect against unauthorized manipulations. However, these methods usually require access to the model weights and the image manipulating prompt. This significantly limits their use, especially against powerful commercial image-editors such as GPT-Image, Gemini Flash Image (Nano Banana), and Grok Imagine. To address this, we take a system-level view of the problem and identify a previously unexplored attack surface common to all major commercial image editing systems: pre-generation safety moderation.Rather than disrupting the generative model itself, we propose to immunize images by causing these moderation classifiers to flag images as policy-violating, triggering an automatic refusal regardless of the editing prompt. We operationalize this by adding adversarial perturbations to align our image to policy-violating concepts in the representation space of an ensemble of open-source embedding and moderation models. We call our method MIRAGE, which stands for Moderation Induced Resistance Against Generative Editing. We evaluate MIRAGE against multiple closed-source image editing APIs and demonstrate success rates of more than 88%. Our approach is simple, prompt-agnostic, and effective, offering a practical path towards protecting personal images from unauthorized AI-powered editing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着AI驱动的图像编辑系统（如GPT-Image、Gemini Flash Image、Grok Imagine）的广泛使用，个人图像可以被大规模、低成本地任意篡改，引发了严重的隐私与安全担忧。现有的图像免疫方法通过在图像中添加人眼不可见的微小扰动来阻止未授权的编辑，但这些方法通常需要访问到图像编辑模型的权重以及用户输入的编辑提示词，导致在实际中难以应用，尤其是针对不开源的商业编辑系统。本文作者从系统层面重新审视该问题，发现所有主流商业图像编辑系统都存在一个此前未被探索的共性攻击面：生成前的安全审核（pre-generation safety moderation）。作者提出一种新的免疫方法MIRAGE（Moderation Induced Resistance Against Generative Editing），其核心思路不是直接破坏生成模型本身，而是通过添加对抗性扰动，使安全审核分类器将图像误判为违反策略的内容，从而无论编辑提示词如何，系统都会自动拒绝编辑。具体技术手段是：利用多个开源嵌入模型和审核模型的集成，在它们的表示空间中，将目标图像向违反策略的概念方向对齐，生成对抗扰动。实验评估针对多个闭源图像编辑API（如GPT-Image等），MIRAGE取得了超过88%的成功率。该方法具有简单、与提示词无关、效果显著的特点，为保护个人图像免受未授权AI编辑提供了一条实用路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MIRAGE揭示了一个新的攻击面——利用商业图像编辑系统的安全审核模块，以无需知道模型权重或提示词的方式阻止编辑。这对蓝队而言，意味着需要重新审视安全审核机制的鲁棒性，并考虑对抗样本对基于审核的防御策略的潜在影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 方法针对主流商业图像编辑API有效，可迁移至任何包含预生成安全审核的图像编辑系统。对于依赖审核机制保护内容安全的平台，此攻击方法可作为压力测试工具，但同时也说明现有审核模型存在被对抗样本绕过的风险。

items.title: BlowLive: Blow-Based Multi-Factor Biometrics with Liveness Detection and Revocability
items.summary: Biometric authentication systems are increasingly deployed in security-critical applications, yet existing physiological and behavioral biometrics suffer from fundamental limitations: 1) they are vulnerable to spoofing attacks due to unreliable liveness detection, 2) biometric templates may leak privacy-sensitive information 3) intra-user variability results in accuracy degradation, and 4) it is difficult to revoke physiological biometrics and safeguard them over long-term use. To address these challenges, we propose BlowLive, a robust multi-factor biometric (MFB) framework that integrates blow-acoustic signals and facial biometrics as complementary behavioral and physiological modalities. BlowLive incorporates advanced spectral feature extraction and multimodal fusion techniques, achieving high authentication accuracy even for behavioral modalities. Instead of relying on conventional biometric approaches that utilize raw biometric templates for authentication, the proposed framework adopts a fuzzy-extractor-based biometric authentication scheme, wherein stable cryptographic keys are derived from inherently noisy biometric inputs and subsequently used for authentication. To defend against playback, synthetic, and deepfake attacks, BlowLive further integrates a novel Doppler shift-based liveness detection mechanism. We implement the complete BlowLive framework and experimentally evaluate its effectiveness using biometric data collected from 50 participants. The experimental results demonstrate high authentication accuracy (99.56% for blow-acoustics and 100% for facial and fusion modalities), robust liveness detection (99.42% accuracy), strong template protection and revocability, non-invasiveness, and high usability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文提出了一种名为 BlowLive 的多因素生物特征认证框架，旨在解决传统生理和行为生物特征的四个核心局限：活体检测不可靠导致易受欺骗攻击、生物特征模板泄露隐私、用户内变异性造成精度下降、以及生理特征难以撤销和长期保护。BlowLive 结合吹气声学信号和面部生物特征作为互补的行为与生理模态，通过先进的光谱特征提取和多模态融合技术实现了高认证精度（吹气模态99.56%，面部及融合模态100%）。它采用基于模糊提取器的生物特征认证方案，从噪声生物特征中推导稳定加密密钥用于认证，从而保护模板隐私并支持密钥撤销。为防御重放、合成及深度伪造攻击，BlowLive 创新性地引入基于多普勒频移的活体检测机制，实验显示活体检测准确率达99.42%。系统在50名参与者数据上验证了高精度、鲁棒活体检测、强模板保护、可撤销性、非侵入性和高可用性。本研究为生物特征认证提供了更安全、隐私友好且实用的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: BlowLive 通过多模态融合和基于多普勒频移的活体检测，显著提升了生物特征认证系统抗欺骗能力，同时解决了模板撤销难题，对安全关键领域（如金融、边境管控）的身份认证具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于需要高安全级生物特征认证的场景，如移动设备解锁、门禁系统、远程身份验证等，也可推广至其他行为-生理融合认证系统。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估将吹气声学模态融合或基于多普勒频移活体检测技术纳入自身生物识别系统的可行性。

items.title: Do (Not) Tell Me About My Insecurities: Assessing the Status Quo of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure in Germany Amid New EU Cybersecurity Regulations
items.summary: In our increasingly interconnected world, good IT security practices are necessary to prevent vulnerabilities and data breaches. Providing security contacts, e.g., via Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) programs or security.txt files, is an important practice for businesses to facilitate vulnerability reporting by external parties. As part of a longitudinal study, we analyzed the adoption of, as well as the challenges and experiences with, CVD programs among the 40 companies listed on Germany's DAX (the country's primary stock market index). In addition to monitoring publicly available information about their CVD programs, we sent out questionnaires via email and postal mail in 2023 and 2025, and received answers from 20\% of the companies. The adoption rates show a significant increase from 50\% (2023) to over 90\% (2025), with ten new CVD programs and 25 new security.txt files now available. The survey answers reveal that, for example, legal obligations (e.g., NIS2 and CRA) drive the adoption of CVD practices, but a lack of (human) resources and varying report quality are considered drawbacks. As the first study to survey 40 German stock market index (DAX) companies on their CVD practices, our results can help foster the adoption and understanding of security programs among SMEs and other companies, and provide policymakers with insights into practical challenges and industry experiences.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一项关于德国DAX指数40家上市公司协调漏洞披露（CVD）实践采纳情况的纵向研究。研究结合公开信息监控与问卷调研（2023年和2025年各一轮，回复率20%），分析了CVD项目及security.txt文件的采纳趋势、企业面临的挑战与经验。结果显示，采纳率从2023年的50%显著提升至2025年的90%以上，新增10个CVD项目和25个security.txt文件。问卷调查表明，法律义务（如NIS2指令和《网络弹性法案》）是主要驱动因素，而缺乏人力、报告质量参差不齐是主要障碍。作为首项针对德国DAX公司CVD实践的系统研究，本文为中小企业推广安全项目提供了参考，并为政策制定者揭示了行业实际挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了德国大型企业CVD采纳现状及法规驱动效应，为安全团队评估自身CVD成熟度提供基准，同时为政策合规提供实证数据。

items.title: A Tattered Cloak of Invisibility: Measuring Anonymity Loss in Railgun on Ethereum
items.summary: From a user's perspective, perhaps the most significant difference between traditional banking services and widely used blockchain-based financial systems is that, in the latter, transactions and, either directly or indirectly, account balances and transaction histories are publicly observable. Therefore, a growing number of cryptographic solutions have been proposed to add a privacy layer to such systems. However, the privacy that users actually obtain does not depend solely on the security of the underlying cryptographic protocol: user behavior, transaction amount patterns, and timing decisions can substantially reduce anonymity. In this work, we study behavioral leakage in cryptocurrency mixers, focusing on Railgun on Ethereum. We aim to heuristically estimate the probability that a given deposit and withdrawal transaction belong to the same user. We consider five sources of leakage: characteristic timing patterns, address reuse, proximity in the transaction graph induced by prior public transactions, amount fingerprints that preserve distinctive digit patterns across transaction values, and knapsack type matches in which groups of transaction amounts add up in revealing ways. Our results show that even cryptographically strong privacy systems may suffer substantial anonymity loss due to user behavior and transaction patterns. Our five heuristics are able to uniquely link 17.65% of Railgun withdraw transactions to deposit transactions. We also applied a knapsack solver algorithm that was able to produce a 3.42 bit median anonymity loss for withdraw transactions. This work contributes to a better understanding of the practical privacy limits of mixers and anonymity pools, and points toward safer usage practices and design principles.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对以太坊上的隐私混币器 Railgun 进行了系统的匿名性损失测量研究。研究背景是，尽管区块链系统提供了透明性，但用户期望通过混币器实现隐私保护；然而实际匿名性不仅取决于底层加密协议的安全性，还受用户行为模式、交易金额特征和时间特征等行为泄露影响。作者提出了五种启发式方法来估计同一用户的存款和取款交易关联概率：1）特征时间模式（如交易间隔的统计分布）；2）地址重用（存款与取款地址重叠）；3）先前公开交易图中的近邻关系；4）金额指纹（交易金额保留独特数字模式）；5）背包问题匹配（多笔交易金额组合成有意义的数字）。通过对 Railgun 实际交易数据的分析，结果显示这些启发式方法能够唯一地将17.65%的取款交易与存款交易链接起来；同时，一个背包求解算法表明取款交易的中位匿名损失为3.42比特。该研究揭示了即使使用密码学上强的隐私系统，用户行为仍会导致显著的匿名性退化。本文贡献在于量化了混币器中的行为泄露，为更安全的使用实践和系统设计提供了指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对于关注加密货币隐私的蓝队及安全研究员，该研究揭示了混币器等隐私工具的实际匿名性受用户行为严重影响，提醒安全从业者在评估隐私方案时需考虑行为层面的泄露，而非仅依赖密码学强度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响以太坊上使用 Railgun 的用户匿名性，可迁移至其他匿名池或混币器（如 Tornado Cash），为监管追踪提供潜在启发，同时警示隐私工具设计应纳入行为反制措施。

items.why_it_matters: 对于关注加密货币隐私的蓝队及安全研究员，该研究揭示了混币器等隐私工具的实际匿名性受用户行为严重影响，提醒安全从业者在评估隐私方案时需考虑行为层面的泄露，而非仅依赖密码学强度。

items.title: Federated Hash Projected Latent Factor Learning
items.summary: Hash Learning (HL) is an efficient representation learning approach that maps real-valued data into compact binary representations. Traditional HL methods typically require users to upload personal data to a central server, which is incompatible with increasingly stringent data security regulations. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized paradigm for learning globally optimal models without centralizing private data. However, most FL methods rely on transmitting large-scale real-valued gradient information, leading to high communication overhead and potential privacy risks. Integrating HL into FL is a promising solution. Nevertheless, existing HL methods suffer from limited representational capacity of binary codes, which may degrade model accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a Federated Hash Projected Latent Factor (FHPLF) model. FHPLF introduces three key innovations: (a) replacing real-valued gradient matrices with binary gradient-like matrices, significantly reducing computation, storage, and communication costs while enhancing privacy protection; (b) leveraging Projected Hamming Distance for similarity modeling, which captures the importance of individual binary bits to improve representation capability; and (c) proposing a Secure Binary Gradient Reassembly and Privacy-Enhanced Upload (SBG-PEU) strategy to further reduce the risk of user interaction leakage during transmission. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that FHPLF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art HL and FL methods, achieving a favorable trade-off among accuracy, efficiency, and privacy preservation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种联邦哈希投影潜在因子学习（FHPLF）模型，旨在解决联邦学习（FL）中通信开销高、隐私风险大以及哈希学习（HL）二进制码表示能力有限的问题。传统哈希学习需要用户上传原始数据至中心服务器，违反数据安全法规；而联邦学习虽能保护本地数据，但需传输大规模实值梯度信息，导致高通信成本且可能泄露隐私。将哈希学习融入联邦学习可降低通信量，但现有方法因二进制码表示能力不足而影响模型精度。FHPLF通过三项创新解决上述挑战：首先，用二值化梯度矩阵替代实值梯度矩阵，大幅降低计算、存储和通信成本，同时增强隐私保护；其次，采用投影汉明距离进行相似性建模，强调各个二进制位的权重以提升表示能力；最后，提出安全二进制梯度重组与隐私增强上传（SBG-PEU）策略，进一步降低传输过程中用户交互泄漏的风险。在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，FHPLF在准确率、效率和隐私保护之间取得了优于现有哈希学习和联邦学习方法的平衡。该工作适用于隐私敏感场景下的高效联邦学习系统设计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为联邦学习中的通信与隐私权衡提供了新思路，对构建高效且合规的分布式机器学习系统具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至移动设备、物联网等带宽受限且隐私要求高的联邦学习场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为联邦学习中的通信与隐私权衡提供了新思路，对构建高效且合规的分布式机器学习系统具有参考价值。

items.title: The Web4 Agent Economy: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of the Landscape, Challenges, and Opportunities
items.summary: The Internet is transitioning from Web3 toward Web4, where autonomous agents serve as independent economic actors. These agents can now hold crypto wallets, execute on-chain trades, and pay for external API calls. This transition calls for a new infrastructure stack capable of supporting key agent operations, including agent-to-tool interaction, agent-to-agent payments, and verifiable agent identity, represented by emerging protocols such as the Model Context Protocol, x402, and EIP-8004. Despite growing industrial interest in these protocols, the real-world Web4 agent ecosystem remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of the Web4 ecosystem. Specifically, our study targets three interconnected questions: how Web4 agents are deployed and used in practice; what engineering challenges developers face when building Web4 agents; how current project communities respond to these challenges. To answer these questions, we analyze 99,448 multi-chain identity registrations, 317,596,323 transaction logs, the source code of 341 MCP projects, and 349 filtered GitHub issues. Our findings reveal that autonomous agents have established a highly active machine-to-machine payment economy, processing millions of daily transactions. However, this growth is built on immature infrastructure, including identity/authorization practice, cross-environment operation, and payment interoperability. Our follow-up analysis shows that community responses are visible but unevenly distributed across repositories, and payment interoperability remains the most persistent unresolved bottleneck. Overall, this study reveals a critical gap between the rapid growth of the Web4 agent economy and its fragile underlying infrastructure, highlighting future directions for building a more secure Web4 agent ecosystem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对Web4代理经济进行了首次大规模实证研究。随着互联网从Web3向Web4演进，自主代理已成为独立的经济参与者，能够持有加密钱包、执行链上交易并支付外部API调用费用。这一转变催生了新的基础设施堆栈，包括模型上下文协议（MCP）、x402和EIP-8004等协议，以支持代理与工具交互、代理间支付和可验证代理身份。尽管业界对这些协议兴趣日增，但真实的Web4代理生态系统仍未被充分探索。为填补这一空白，作者分析了99,448条多链身份注册记录、317,596,323条交易日志、341个MCP项目的源代码以及349个GitHub问题。研究发现，自主代理已建立起高度活跃的机器对机器支付经济，每日处理数百万笔交易。然而，这种增长建立在脆弱的基础设施之上，存在身份/授权实践、跨环境操作和支付互操作性等挑战。社区回应可见但分布不均，支付互操作性成为最持久的瓶颈。研究揭示了Web4代理经济的快速增长与其底层基础设施脆弱性之间的关键差距，为构建更安全的Web4代理生态系统指明了方向。该研究适合安全工程师、区块链开发者、协议设计者以及关注自主代理经济的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了Web4代理经济中基础设施的安全短板（如身份授权、支付互操作性），为防御者提前识别自主代理场景下的攻击面（如钱包劫持、未授权交易）提供了实证依据。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了Web4代理经济中基础设施的安全短板（如身份授权、支付互操作性），为防御者提前识别自主代理场景下的攻击面（如钱包劫持、未授权交易）提供了实证依据。

items.title: Automated Detection of Configuration-Specific Security Vulnerabilities via Patch Analysis
items.summary: We study how security patches in highly configurable C/C++ systems map onto the space of compile-time variants. We formalize the Vulnerability Impact Condition (VIC) - a Boolean predicate over configuration options that denotes all variants that contained the original flaw - and introduce PatchLens, a purely static technique that recovers VICs by aligning AST-level patch hunks with source-level presence conditions and resolving file inclusion via lightweight build system analysis. Evaluating PatchLens on 1,192 Linux kernel, 289 FFmpeg, and 100 PHP patches, we compute precise, human-readable VICs without the need to compile any system variant. The resulting predicates are compact (avg. 1.84 variables for Linux, 3.23 for FFmpeg, 1.04 for PHP) and show that only a small fraction of vulnerabilities are system-wide, which carry higher CVSS scores; meanwhile, CVE texts almost never encode the required options ($\approx$ 1% average recall), motivating automated enrichment of CVE descriptions with VICs. PatchLens and the accompanying dataset enable immediate applications in CI (variant-aware triage and test selection), targeted sampling and fuzzing, and feature risk scoring, offering a scalable, explainable path to vulnerability assessment in highly configurable software.
authors: Paulo Anselmo da Mota Silveira Neto

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对高度可配置的C/C++系统（如Linux内核、FFmpeg、PHP）中的安全漏洞检测问题，提出了一种基于补丁分析的自动化方法。核心创新在于形式化了“漏洞影响条件”（Vulnerability Impact Condition, VIC），即一个布尔谓词，用于描述哪些编译时配置选项组合会导致系统包含原始缺陷。作者开发了PatchLens工具，采用纯静态分析技术：通过将AST级别的补丁块与源代码中的存在条件对齐，并结合轻量级构建系统分析来解析文件包含，从而恢复VIC，无需编译任何系统变体。实验在1192个Linux内核补丁、289个FFmpeg补丁和100个PHP补丁上进行，结果表明PatchLens能够生成精确且人类可读的VIC，平均变量数分别为1.84、3.23和1.04。研究发现，只有少数漏洞是全系统范围的，而这些漏洞通常具有更高的CVSS分数。此外，现有CVE描述几乎不包含所需的配置选项信息（平均召回率约1%），因此作者建议用VIC自动丰富CVE描述。PatchLens及配套数据集支持多种实际应用，包括CI流水线中的变体感知分类和测试选择、定向采样与模糊测试，以及特征风险评分，为高可配置软件中的漏洞评估提供了可扩展且可解释的解决方案。本文适合安全研究者和软件工程从业者阅读，尤其关注配置复杂度较高的系统。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统漏洞检测难以应对编译时配置爆炸问题，PatchLens提供了一种无需编译的静态补丁分析方案，能精确定位受影响的配置变体，显著提升高可配置软件（如Linux内核）的安全评估效率。其VIC形式化也有望自动化丰富CVE，弥补当前描述缺失。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于各类高可配置C/C++项目（如操作系统、嵌入式系统、媒体库），可集成到CI/CD管道中实现变体敏感的安全检查。也可用于定向模糊测试和风险评分，减少无效测试。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进并评估PatchLens在自己负责的高可配置软件项目中的适用性，考虑将VIC信息集成到漏洞管理流程中。

items.title: Color Matters: Trigger Color Affects Success in Federated Backdoor Attacks
items.summary: Federated learning is vulnerable to backdoor attacks in which malicious clients inject poisoned updates while preserving benign-task performance. In this paper, we study a semantics-driven backdoor mechanism in which attackers use natural visual accessories as triggers and manipulate only the trigger color while keeping the attack pipeline fixed. Our framework considers semantic trigger objects such as masks and sunglasses, instantiated in black and white variants, and evaluates their effect in a controlled federated learning setting. Malicious clients construct poisoned samples by applying a trigger to source-class images and relabeling them to an attacker-chosen target class, while benign clients train only on clean data. We analyze this mechanism under both a standard poisoning objective and a stronger SABLE-based objective that combines clean classification loss, triggered target loss, feature-separation loss in the penultimate representation space, and regularization to keep malicious updates close to the global model. This design enables the attack to remain effective while reducing excessive update drift. Experiments on a four-class CelebA hair-color task show that trigger color significantly changes attack success rate even when trigger semantics, placement, and poisoning budget are unchanged. White triggers are more effective for attacks targeting the blond class, whereas black triggers perform better for attacks targeting the black class. The same trend persists under robust aggregation, showing that trigger color is a meaningful factor in the operation, persistence, and evaluation of semantic backdoor mechanisms in federated learning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了联邦学习中基于语义的后门攻击机制，重点探讨了触发器颜色对攻击成功率的影响。联邦学习易受后门攻击，恶意客户端注入带有后门的模型更新，同时保持良性任务性能。作者提出一种语义驱动的后门方式，攻击者使用自然的视觉配件（如口罩、太阳镜）作为触发器，并仅改变触发器的颜色，而保持攻击流程不变。实验基于CelebA数据集上的四类发色任务（blond、black、brown、others），恶意客户端将触发器应用到源类图像并重新标记为目标类，良性客户端仅训练干净数据。攻击目标包括标准投毒目标以及更强的SABLE目标，后者结合了干净分类损失、触发目标损失、特征分离损失和正则化，使恶意更新贴近全局模型以减少漂移。结果表明，即使在触发语义、位置和投毒预算不变的情况下，触发器颜色显著改变了攻击成功率：白色触发器对针对blond类的攻击更有效，黑色触发器对针对black类的攻击更有效。该趋势在鲁棒聚合下依然存在，说明颜色是影响语义后门机制操作、持久性和评估的重要因素。本文贡献在于揭示了颜色作为后门攻击中一个被忽视的维度，并提供了系统的实验分析。适合联邦学习安全研究人员、AI安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了联邦学习中后门攻击的一个新维度——触发器颜色，说明即使是细微的视觉特征也会显著影响攻击效果，为防御方案设计提供了新视角。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响联邦学习系统的后门攻击评估与防御策略，特别是基于视觉触发器的攻击场景。可迁移至其他多模态或语义触发攻击的研究。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了联邦学习中后门攻击的一个新维度——触发器颜色，说明即使是细微的视觉特征也会显著影响攻击效果，为防御方案设计提供了新视角。

items.title: Can Machine Learning Break Wi-Fi Privacy? A Study on MAC Address Randomization
items.summary: Medium Access Control (MAC) address randomization has been widely adopted during the IEEE 802.11 network discovery phase as a countermeasure against passive tracking. This paper exposes vulnerabilities in these privacy protocols by demonstrating that devices remain identifiable using Machine Learning (ML)-based fingerprinting. To study the potential tracking capabilities of a passive attacker, we evaluate different eavesdropping scenarios and configurations. To this end, we extract unencrypted hardware specifications from Probe Frames, which we combine with the Inter-Probe Frame Arrival Time (IFAT) and Simulated Received Signal Strength Indication (SRSSI) signals. A core contribution of this paper is the bitwise decomposition of the High Throughput (HT) capabilities information field, which improves device identification accuracy. We evaluate this de-randomization approach using three unsupervised clustering algorithms (K-Means, DBSCAN, and OPTICS) across a dataset of 22 devices from six manufacturers. Our results show that DBSCAN, when using decomposed HT capabilities information and three SRSSI measurements, achieves a global accuracy up to 89.6%. This suggests that the existing MAC randomization solutions are insufficient and underscores the need for enhancing privacy within Wi-Fi standardization.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了IEEE 802.11网络中广泛采用的MAC地址随机化机制在被动追踪防护方面的有效性。作者通过实验证明，即使设备使用了MAC随机化，攻击者仍然可以利用机器学习技术识别设备身份。论文核心方法是从探测帧（Probe Frames）中提取未加密的硬件规格信息，特别是对高吞吐量（HT）能力信息字段进行逐位分解，并结合探测帧间隔时间（IFAT）和模拟接收信号强度指示（SRSSI）信号。作者使用K-Means、DBSCAN和OPTICS三种无监督聚类算法，在包含来自6个制造商的22个设备的数据集上评估了去随机化效果。实验结果表明，DBSCAN算法在使用分解后的HT能力信息和三个SRSSI测量值时，全局准确率可达89.6%。该发现揭示了现有MAC随机化解决方案不足以防止设备身份识别，凸显了在Wi-Fi标准中增强隐私保护的必要性。本论文适合无线网络安全研究人员、协议设计者以及关注隐私保护的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了MAC地址随机化这一主流隐私保护机制存在严重缺陷，攻击者可以低成本地通过机器学习突破隐私保护，对移动设备用户的轨迹追踪和身份识别构成实际威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响Wi-Fi网络环境下用户的被动追踪风险；相关技术可迁移至其他无线协议（如蓝牙、ZigBee）的设备指纹识别场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了MAC地址随机化这一主流隐私保护机制存在严重缺陷，攻击者可以低成本地通过机器学习突破隐私保护，对移动设备用户的轨迹追踪和身份识别构成实际威胁。

items.title: Space-based Missile Defense
items.summary: This paper reviews the technical issues underlying space-based boost-phase missile defense and examines the current technology available for space-based interceptors and the characteristics of the missiles such a system would face. It then analyzes a particular space-based missile defense system that has been proposed to intercept in boost, ascent, and midcourse phases to illustrate the details of such an analysis and the constraints imposed on such systems by the physics of operating in space.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文由David Wright撰写，旨在系统性地评估天基助推段导弹防御的技术可行性与物理约束。研究背景：随着导弹技术的扩散，各国对反导系统的需求日益增长，但基于太空的拦截方案因轨道力学、燃料限制、交战时间窗口等物理因素面临严峻挑战。核心问题：天基拦截器能否在助推段、上升段及中段有效拦截弹道导弹？论文首先梳理了当前天基拦截器技术（如动能杀伤飞行器、红外传感、推进系统）的性能参数，以及靶标导弹（如洲际弹道导弹、潜射弹道导弹）的典型飞行剖面。接着，它构建了一个具体的、曾被提议的天基导弹防御系统模型，该系统设计用于覆盖助推段、上升段及中段拦截。通过仿真分析，量化了拦截器部署数量、轨道高度、燃料消耗、覆盖范围、交战时间窗口等关键指标之间的权衡关系。主要贡献：（1）揭示了在物理定律（如轨道力学、比冲限制）下，天基反导系统所需拦截器数量远超常规划，且生存能力脆弱；（2）论证了助推段拦截因导弹燃烧时间短、拦截器需在极窄窗口内进入交战轨道而几乎不可行；（3）指出中段拦截虽时间窗口更长，但面临诱饵、假目标等对抗手段。论文适合国防政策制定者、军事技术分析师及航天工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 天基导弹防御是国防安全的关键议题，论文揭示了其物理局限性，有助于安全从业者理解太空战技术瓶颈，避免过度投资不切实际的防御方案。
